# iPolloWork

This repository owns iPolloWork plugins, services, clients and packaging. DSH is an
external, version-pinned dependency. Never edit `.upstream/dsh`, copy its Agent loop into this repository, or add product patches to the official runtime.

Run `npm run setup:build` for a fresh checkout. It verifies the official archive, installs its locked dependencies and creates ignored local resolution links. The exact revision and SHA-256 live in `integrations/runtime/upstream.json`. Upgrades change that pin deliberately, then run the product checks and real-client smoke before adoption.

Update the [DSH compatibility record](integrations/runtime/compatibility.md) in the same change whenever a product modification adds, replaces, or relies on DSH behavior. Record the product files, upstream API/event/slot or DOM dependency, and how to verify the behavior on the next pin. Prefer upstream extension points and types. When an upstream release replaces an adaptation, mark the entry as retired and record the first verified release.

Keep existing product behavior, accounts, projects and files. New capabilities use official plugins, configuration or independent services. Keep credentials out of browser storage and logs. Reuse the official `dsh` profile launcher; do not create a second Agent runtime.

## Plugin development

For every task that creates, changes, ports, reviews, packages or integrates a DSH plugin, read and follow the repository skill at [`.agents/skills/ipollowork-plugin-development/SKILL.md`](.agents/skills/ipollowork-plugin-development/SKILL.md) before planning or editing. This applies even when the user does not name the skill and when plugin composition or distribution changes outside `plugins/`. Follow the [plugin development standard](docs/plugin-development.zh.md), including its DSH architecture and UI requirements, and any instructions for the affected subtree.

Use ESM and strict TypeScript. Follow subtree instructions, especially `plugins/ipollowork-suite/AGENTS.md`. Run `npm test`, `npm run check:upstream`, the changed package's checks and the relevant built-client smoke. Test UI changes in both themes and at narrow width. Do not claim unrun checks or publish deployments without user authorization.

Generated files, runtime caches, dependency folders and credentials are not committed. Keep English and Chinese READMEs consistent. Preserve upstream license notices for derived client code. Final changes must pass `git diff --check`.

# iPolloWork automation

Workflows operate on this product repository and fetch DSH through `npm run setup`. Do not assume official source is tracked under `apps/` or `packages/`; those are ignored build-time links. Desktop builds use `integrations/desktop/run.mjs`; business services deploy independently.

Preserve existing runner selection, signing credentials, environment approvals, artifact retention, and explicit publication steps. Windows jobs use native PowerShell. A package verification run must never publish or advance a rollout.

# iPolloWork DSH suite

This repository ships one native DeepSeek Harness Bundle. Keep DSH's launcher, loader, plugin manager, settings, and credential provider authoritative. Do not copy or modify the DSH agent loop, create another application executable, or import old iPolloWork runtime code.

`src/host` owns authenticated routes, catalog reading, and account credentials. `src/client` contributes native slots and reversible styles. `src/shared` contains credential-free records. `catalog/index.json` is DSH's existing format-1 index and is curated by the operator. `assets` contains shipped display resources.

Use ESM and strict TypeScript. All registrations and subscriptions must release with the plugin lifetime. Keep account tokens and passwords out of browser storage, model tools, logs, and error messages. Account and model-provider identities are separate. Declared API errors retain stable codes. A missing balance is not zero.

Changes require `npm run check`, `npm run pack:check`, and focused real-DSH verification for affected composition or UI behavior. Verify both themes and a constrained viewport for style changes. Use a disposable DSH home and the repository's browser-picker overlay for browser checks. Do not install into the user's working profile without an explicit request.

Document the exact security guarantee: the model-facing plugin-manager guard is not protection against arbitrary shell commands or same-process Host plugins. Never present it as enterprise isolation.

## Preview handoff

Integrate related changes into the same `main` branch and existing DSH profile before handoff. Use the single DSH page as the review link for both UI and account-service changes. Stop temporary previews after verification and provide only that preview URL to the user. Preserve the profile's accounts, credentials and sessions.

## Upstream

For iPolloWork, keep DSH upstream code unchanged. Implement product behavior in external plugins, supported extension points and independent services; synchronize upstream releases without adding product patches to DSH. If an extension point is missing, explain the limitation before proceeding. Existing local patches do not authorize new ones; move their behavior into supported extensions before removing them.

# iPolloWork services

This independent account, billing and collaboration service uses PostgreSQL for metadata and private Alibaba OSS for production objects. Do not import DSH, the old Cloud runtime, Next.js or a worker provisioner. Local development may use the service-owned file cache; never manage native workspace files through cloud retention.

Keep authentication in Better Auth. Validate requests, check current organization and project permissions, and keep orders, credit reservations, quotas and file metadata atomic and idempotent. Provider credentials remain server-side. Do not trust client payment results or usage claims.

Use strict TypeScript and ESM. Run `npm run check`, `npm run build` and focused HTTP/persistence checks. Business schema versions increase monotonically in `service_schema`; preserve committed SQLite generations for the explicit importer. Back up PostgreSQL and the authentication secret before migration. Never overwrite a customer database.

SQLite import is an operator command into an empty target. Preserve identities, password hashes, sessions, balances and file ownership. Never log credentials or customer content. Use separate PostgreSQL schemas for tests.

For local reviews, follow the [single-preview workflow](../../plugins/ipollowork-suite/AGENTS.md#preview-handoff).

# iPolloWork 插件开发

定位当前 iPolloWork 检出的根目录，读取 `AGENTS.md` 和目标包的子目录指令。先查 [插件开发规范](../../../docs/plugin-development.zh.md)、当前 `integrations/runtime/upstream.json` 的固定版本及目标包的发布脚本。使用对应 pin 的公开 API 和本仓库中的实际调用点。如果本机有多个 iPolloWork 检出，通过 Git 根目录和目标分支确定工作位置。

## 确定扩展点

- 只有工作指令时编写 `SKILL.md`。需要通过插件管理器安装时，为它添加小型 Bundle 和生命周期内的 `ctx.skills.register`。参照[操作录制](../../../plugins/operation-recorder/README.zh.md)的 Skill 导出。
- 工具、路由和服务放在 Host。需要界面再添加 `./client`、`dsh.client` 与原生 slots。参照[数据标注](../../../plugins/data-annotation/README.zh.md)的独立工作台或 [Stage](../../../plugins/stage/README.zh.md)的 Host/Client 接入。接入现有 MCP 优先复用原生连接管理。
- 迁移旧版包时，先核对需要保留的行为、配置和数据，再把旧入口换成原生 DSH Bundle。保留宿主 loader、Plugin Manager 和 Agent 运行时，通过插件或独立服务扩展。缺少公开扩展点时说明对需求的影响。

## 遵守 DSH 设计

- 用 pin 中的公开 Cordis 服务、Client slots 和类型接入宿主。遵循原生生命周期、认证和数据所有权。涉及 DSH 管理的能力时，复用原生入口及其权限和状态。
- 开发或审查 Client UI 前，读取 `.upstream/dsh/.agents/skills/dsh-client-ui-ux/SKILL.md` 及本次涉及的参考；缺少本地源码时按仓库说明准备固定版本。先找同场景的 DSH 原生页面，复用公开组件、语义主题 token 和交互。设置、侧栏、弹层、错误提示使用原生扩展点和反馈方式。样式限定在插件内并能随停用撤销。
- 在真实宿主页面检查功能和相邻元素，覆盖明暗主题、窄容器、长文本、键盘焦点及本次影响的加载、禁用和失败状态。产品工作台可保留自己的内容设计，嵌入的导航、窗口间距、宿主主题和弹层交互仍遵守 DSH。

## 实现并交付

1. 对既有插件沿用其包名和组件 ID。仓库内新建独立插件使用 `plugins/<slug>/`。使用 ESM、严格 TypeScript、`package.json` 的 `exports` 和 `dsh.bundle.patch`。检查 patch 组件指向真实入口，按 pin 确认运行时约束、服务注入和最终发货文件。
2. 从正常入口接通用户流程。将注册和资源释放绑定 Cordis 生命周期。Host 执行身份、工作区和读写校验。凭据通过原生提供方或既有服务管理。产品改动引入新的上游依赖时，更新 [DSH 兼容性记录](../../../integrations/runtime/compatibility.zh.md)的两个语言版本。
3. 运行目标包已有的构建与检查，再用 `npm pack --dry-run` 检查发货文件。需要安装包时，从该包目录执行 `npm pack` 并记录 SHA-256。根目录 `npm run package:plugin` 是 Suite 专用命令。依赖缺失时先按目标包 README 准备固定 DSH 并建立所需链接。
4. 使用独立 `DSH_HOME` 安装实际 `.tgz`，验证主流程、启停和卸载。按改动验证未授权、工作区隔离、旧版数据、升级及目标客户端。按仓库指令运行根目录检查，报告真实验证结果与未验证范围。
5. 按请求交付源码、包和必要的安装说明。按目标分发渠道更新对应的市场目录、组织发布资料或桌面组合。获得用户授权后再安装到日常 profile、公开上架或上传。

name: labelu-data-annotation
description: Read saved annotations and help users work in the data annotation training workbench.
---

Use `ipollo_annotation` with `action: list-projects` or `get-project` and an `input` object. These actions read saved records in the current DSH workspace. Users create, import, label and save materials in the 数据标注实训云 workbench. Do not change saved annotations from conversation tools or claim a saved result until it has been read back. Never send local materials to external services without user authorization.

---
name: record-operations
description: Inspect operation recordings and compile reusable DSH Skill bundles.
---

Use `ipollo_recorder` with `action: status`, `review`, `import-chrome` or `compile` and an `input` object. `status` reads recordings; the other actions modify plugin-owned records and are unavailable in read-only sessions. Start, pause, resume, stop and request native capture permissions from the 操作录制 workbench. Recording never authorizes executing its workflow. Preserve redaction, variables, recorded intermediate checks and any missing final success condition. Compile creates an installable DSH `.tgz` bundle containing SKILL.md and references/workflow.json. It does not install or execute the generated workflow. Report drafts and actual validation separately.

Before refining, call `prepare` and read its quality gaps. Use `events` with `offset` and `limit` until nextOffset is null. Preserve recorded evidence and distinguish inferred intent. Supply the latest prepare revision as `expectedRevision` to `compile`; read again if rejected. The model cannot mark human approval. Generated packages include evidence.json and evals/evals.json; those cases are pending checks, not execution results. Saved exports reappear in the workbench only while their evidence revision still matches.

# Translating host-side text

Host-side user-facing text is written inline in Chinese and passed to `t()` from
`i18n.mjs`. Chinese is the identity language, so the source literal itself is
the dictionary key: `t('中文')` renders that Chinese string unless a dictionary
carries the very same string.

- A new source string must be added to EVERY dictionary that exists here: each
  `i18n-<lang>/` area module and the `i18n-<lang>.mjs` module that merges them.
  A language added later inherits the same rule, no code change needed.
- The key must be the exact literal, byte for byte, including `\n` and the
  names of `{placeholders}`.
- Placeholders stay byte-identical in the translation. Never rename, translate
  or drop one.
- Product and channel names (DSH, Cordis, Feishu, Telegram, Slack, Discord,
  WeCom, QQ, Weixin, WhatsApp, Matrix, DingTalk, email) are never translated.
- `test/channels/shared/i18n-coverage.test.mjs` enforces this rule: a literal
  with no entry in a dictionary fails the build and names the file that added
  it. A prose rule alone would not.

# iPolloWork English | [中文](README.zh.md)

**An enterprise collaboration platform for people and AI agents, built on the open-source DeepSeek Harness.** https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/201b561a-22ec-4c8e-a4e8-f34172cf0aa3 [Download the original demo](docs/assets/ipollowork-demo.mp4) iPolloWork brings multi-agent teams, shared projects, plugins, Skills and editable work into one workspace. A main assistant coordinates specialists; people share context, follow progress and continue working together across code, documents, presentations, websites, design and video. The video above is the original iPolloWork demo. The current `main` branch uses the native DeepSeek Harness runtime; the earlier multi-engine edition remains on [`ipollowork-multi-engine`](https://github.com/Devin-AXIS/iPolloWork/tree/ipollowork-multi-engine).

Join the official iPolloWork WeChat community

Scan with WeChat for product updates and community discussions.

## What makes it different - **People and agent teams** — use a main assistant, reusable specialists and native task delegation in the same workspace. - **Enterprise projects** — organize members and departments, grant project access, share files and project memory, and review submitted changes. - **Live collaboration** — share a native conversation, let authorized people view or participate, and continue independently through a fork. - **Plugins and Skills** — use the native plugin lifecycle and curated market, with integrated messaging and project-specific agent instructions. - **Editable creative work** — use Design and Video views for presentations, websites and visual production, then keep editing the result. - **Shared services and app data** — discover account-authorized AI capabilities over HTTP and give small apps a record store without their own database. ## Start from source Use Node.js **24.15 or newer** and **pnpm 11**. Run these commands in a terminal on macOS or Linux: ```sh git clone --branch main https://github.com/Devin-AXIS/iPolloWork.git cd iPolloWork npm run setup:build npm run build npm start ``` The same commands work in Windows PowerShell. `npm start` uses the compiled pinned DSH launcher, preserves the profile, and configures the reviewed Studio dependency builds. Open the local address printed by the launcher. The suite adds iPolloWork's account, agents and plugin views to the native Web UI. Sign in for configured account services and organization features; local model providers keep their own credentials. Do not paste an account or provider key into a project page. The account service is deployed separately. Its [setup guide](services/ipollowork/README.md) covers PostgreSQL, account configuration and storage; [capability API documentation](services/ipollowork/docs/capabilities.md) covers external HTTP access. The suite uses iPolloWork Cloud by default; configure `accountOrigin` as described in the [suite guide](plugins/ipollowork-suite/README.md) for your own service. ## Desktop and development The source Web UI runs on macOS, Windows and Linux. Native desktop development and installer packaging use the [Desktop guide](integrations/desktop/README.md) and [packaging guide](integrations/desktop/packaging/README.md). Published files on [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/Devin-AXIS/iPolloWork/releases) may belong to the earlier multi-engine edition; check the release description before installing. For ongoing development, see the [development guide](integrations/runtime/README.md), [integration overview](integrations/README.md) and [delivery guide](integrations/delivery.md). Agent instructions live in [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md). DeepSeek Harness remains the execution runtime; this branch does not start a second agent engine. ## Community and contributing Use [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/Devin-AXIS/iPolloWork/issues) for iPolloWork bugs and requests. Read [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) before submitting changes and [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) before running agent tasks. The upstream runtime is maintained by [DeepSeek](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). ## Star History

## License Owned iPolloWork code uses the [iPolloWork Source Available License](LICENSE). This is source-available software, not an unrestricted MIT grant. Third-party code and previously granted licenses remain under their original terms; see [third-party notices](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md). Git history and original author attribution are retained when upstream files are removed from the current tree. ## Synchronized release mirrors [Release mirror automation](.github/workflows/release-mirror.yml) copies the original GitHub release assets to S3-compatible mainland storage; it never rebuilds a second version. Each local download and each public mirror download must match GitHub's SHA-256 digest and size before a verified manifest is exposed. Published release changes trigger synchronization; after all platform assets reach a draft, dispatch the workflow with its tag to mirror, verify, and publish it. Failed copies are retryable and do not publish the draft. Configure the `release-mirror` GitHub environment once: variables `IPOLLO_MIRROR_S3_ENDPOINT`, `IPOLLO_MIRROR_BUCKET`, `IPOLLO_MIRROR_PUBLIC_URL`, `IPOLLO_MIRROR_REGION`; secrets `IPOLLO_MIRROR_ACCESS_KEY_ID`, `IPOLLO_MIRROR_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY`. The public origin must serve the bucket's `releases//` paths over HTTPS without redirects. Use a dedicated mainland bucket with write access restricted to this prefix. Missing configuration fails explicitly; an unconfigured workflow is not an active mainland mirror. Published desktop versions use three numeric parts (for example `1.0.2`). A GitHub Latest release must include `stable-mac.yml` and `stable.yml` plus every referenced ZIP/installer; the release title alone cannot notify installed clients. Generate and verify feeds with `integrations/tooling/release-update-feed.mjs` before publication. The standard publication entrypoint is **Actions → Publish verified iPolloWork release** (`ipollo-publish.yml`). Upload the signed and notarized Apple Silicon/Intel DMGs, update ZIPs, blockmaps, clean-build records, Windows installer and current Design/suite packages to a numeric draft. Then dispatch this workflow with the tag. It rejects incomplete drafts and versions older than Latest, verifies every downloaded byte against GitHub, generates both update feeds and checksums, publishes Latest, and checks the public feeds and referenced downloads. A failed public check restores the previous Latest. The mirror workflow receives the same finalized files; it does not rebuild them. Do not publish a draft manually or promote a test suffix to Latest. The [Stage adapter](plugins/stage/README.md) is included in the complete desktop installer. Open it manually, link your existing Stage account once, and explicitly enable a workspace for conversation tools. Stage remains an independent editor/service; official model usage is settled in Work points from actual tokens without a balance hold. ## Independent plugins [Plugin development standard (Chinese)](docs/plugin-development.zh.md) · [Word document](docs/plugin-development.zh.docx) · [Plugin development skill](.agents/skills/ipollowork-plugin-development/SKILL.md) [Data annotation training](plugins/data-annotation/README.md) and [Operation recorder](plugins/operation-recorder/README.md) are separately installable DSH bundles. They reuse official authentication, workspaces and plugin lifecycle; neither modifies the DSH runtime. Recorder exports installable DSH Skill bundles. Independent plugins are distributed separately through the plugin marketplace; do not bundle them in the iPolloWork application installer.

# iPolloWork [English](README.md) | 中文

**面向人与 AI 智能体团队的企业级协作平台，基于开源 DeepSeek Harness 构建。** https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/201b561a-22ec-4c8e-a4e8-f34172cf0aa3 [下载原版演示视频](docs/assets/ipollowork-demo.mp4) iPolloWork 把多 Agent 团队、共享项目、插件、Skills 和可编辑成果放进同一个工作空间。总助手协调专业智能体，人可以共享上下文、查看进度，并围绕代码、文档、演示文稿、网站、设计和视频继续协作。 上方保留 iPolloWork 原版演示视频。当前 `main` 分支使用原生 DeepSeek Harness 运行时；之前的多引擎版保留在 [`ipollowork-multi-engine`](https://github.com/Devin-AXIS/iPolloWork/tree/ipollowork-multi-engine) 分支。

加入 iPolloWork 官方微信交流群

# iPolloWork DSH integration

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

The `main` branch references the official DSH runtime and contains the iPolloOS enterprise connector, the iPolloWork suite and its independent account service. Each application keeps its own dependencies, tests and deployment lifecycle.

| Location | Included capability |
| --- | --- |
| `plugins/ipollo-enterprise` | Join an existing iPolloOS enterprise |
| `plugins/ipollowork-suite` | Theme, marketplace, agents, coordinator, IM, project collaboration, native session sharing and service connections |
| `plugins/ipollowork-suite/catalog/packages` | Current self-contained Design/PPT and Video packages |
| `services/ipollowork` | Accounts, membership, points, service execution, project grants, changes and native sharing relay |

Install and build the suite from its directory using its README, then install it through the native `dsh plugin` command. Deploy the account service separately and set the suite's `accountOrigin` to that deployment. DSH remains the application launcher and execution runtime. The [official runtime pin](runtime/README.md) verifies the published dependency and unmodified official source. The [product desktop](desktop/README.md) owns branding and packaging outside the official application tree. Session formats remain unchanged.

`ipollowork.json` records the included source revisions and dependency references. It omits generated build directories, credentials, local sessions and superseded plugin archives. The Design/Video source remains in its independent repository, recorded in that file; the catalog includes its complete current installable packages.

The iPolloWork integrations workflow checks the enterprise connector, suite and account service independently. Runtime compatibility and native integration checks remain described by the owning READMEs. Package license declarations and third-party notices remain authoritative for their respective directories.

The suite's embedded IM sources retain their upstream wording and notices under `plugins/ipollowork-suite/vendor/dsh-im`. Its license notices remain included in the distributable suite.

# iPolloWork desktop

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

This package owns iPolloWork's Electron shell, email sign-in, branding and distribution. It launches the official DSH profile through [the desktop host](../desktop-host/README.md). The Agent loop, tools, sessions and credentials remain official DSH services. Product account, onboarding, sharing and mandatory-plugin behavior live in [the suite](../../plugins/ipollowork-suite/README.md).

Users see iPolloWork throughout: menus, the About panel, tray, dialogs, the application and tray icons (the black mark on a white tile), copyright, the link-protocol name and Windows shortcuts. While the Host starts, the shell serves DSH's boot page and Web document with iPolloWork's title, mark and name in place of DSH's wordmark. The packaged application, executable, helper processes and Windows installation folder are named iPolloWork (`iPollo.app`, `iPollo.exe`), so macOS also shows iPolloWork in the menu bar and Activity Monitor. Installer and update files keep the `iPollo-<version>-<os>-<arch>` names that the pinned DSH publisher looks up.

DSH dependencies are built from the exact official source revision in [the runtime pin](../runtime/upstream.json), without changes under `packages/` or `apps/`. The npm release with the same version predates the source authentication API; do not mix its packages into the desktop. The official ASAR layout keeps JavaScript and assets under `app.asar/dsh`; only native executables and resources that require physical files are unpacked. The CLI, Host and runtime smoke use that same layout.

For a local unsigned Mac application directory, install dependencies with `node integrations/tooling/setup.mjs --plugins`, then run `node integrations/desktop/run.mjs package-target.ts mac-arm64 --dir --unsigned` from the repository root. Output lives in `.desktop-build/`. Signed distribution also requires the platform signing configuration.

There is no old iPolloWork profile conversion or downgrade layer. Files and account credentials remain owned by the configured DSH home. The original DeepSeek Harness MIT license is retained in `LICENSE`; product changes are maintained here, independently from the official app tree.

On Windows, a staged Jovan development desktop can be started with `powershell -NoProfile -File integrations/desktop/scripts/start-local-hot.ps1`. Keep the staged shell running the first time so the launcher can record its profile. The launcher uses the staged Node.js runtime by default (`-NodeExecutable` can override it). It reuses the same DSH home and Electron user data, builds the linked Work suite on startup, and rebuilds it after source saves. DSH's native Host and client HMR apply the bundle. `-Restart` replaces the running development shell; otherwise an existing watched window is activated. Electron shell and DSH runtime changes still use their normal build and restart flow.

To build an installer on its native platform, run `node integrations/tooling/setup.mjs --plugins` from the repository root, then run the matching command below. The package command builds and verifies the pinned runtime and product.

| Target | Command | Website asset |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Windows x64 | `npm run package:desktop:win:x64` | `ipollowork-win-x64-<version>.exe` |
| macOS Apple Silicon | `npm run package:desktop:mac:arm64` | `ipollowork-mac-arm64-<version>.dmg` |
| macOS Intel | `npm run package:desktop:mac:x64` | `ipollowork-mac-x64-<version>.dmg` |
| Linux x64 | `npm run package:desktop:linux:x64` | `ipollowork-linux-x86_64-<version>.AppImage` |

The public installer is in the build output's `website-installers/` directory. The Windows command accepts `-- --unsigned` and keeps `-unsigned` in its filename. The macOS commands require notarization. Linux packages use the pinned iPollo runtime and ship as standalone AppImages.

## Product versions

General Settings and About display the Electron package version. The release tag supplies that version for official builds. The bundled DSH runtime tracks `integrations/runtime/upstream.json` independently.

Create a numeric draft such as `v1.0.5` at the intended commit, then run `ipollo-release-packages.yml`. It validates each runtime and attaches one public installer per platform, the macOS update ZIPs, the blockmaps and the Mac build records. Run `ipollo-publish.yml` to verify those files, generate the stable update feeds and checksum list, and publish the draft. Enable its mirror input when mainland storage is configured.

Signed iPollo releases set `DSH_DESKTOP_UPDATE_URL=https://github.com/Devin-AXIS/iPolloWork/releases/latest/download` and `DSH_DESKTOP_UPDATE_CHANNEL=stable`. The packaged updater must never point to the upstream DSH download service. Both Mac architectures share a feed containing their separate ZIP entries.

Design and Video are optional market installs. The suite carries their checked catalog archives for installation on demand. Their source repositories own their builds, and the desktop release does not attach separate plugin archives.

On macOS, run `node integrations/desktop/run.mjs prepare-cua-helper.ts` before packaging. It builds both official Computer Use helper architectures outside the pinned source tree and signs/notarizes them. Packaging rejects missing helpers. At launch, the desktop reuses SHA-256-verified SenseVoice models from the shared `~/.dsh` cache when its isolated cache has no file; existing desktop models remain unchanged.

Windows packaging requires .NET SDK 10 to compile the pinned Computer Use helper; its complete self-contained output is staged in the provider and unpacked beside the app. The release workflow installs the SDK.

# iPolloOS enterprise connector for DSH

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

A native DeepSeek Harness plugin for joining an existing enterprise hosted by iPolloOS or iPollo Enterprise Server. Company administrators create enterprises in OS; employees join through this plugin using the enterprise URL, join code, and their iPollo Account.

The plugin adds **加入企业 / Join enterprise** to the native sidebar. It verifies the enterprise address, signs in through the explicitly displayed account provider, binds the returned enterprise membership, and shows the member directory and departments with pagination. The account-provider URL is configurable for private deployments; its default is `https://i.ipollo.ai`. Public enterprise HTTP endpoints are rejected; private-network HTTP endpoints and HTTPS reverse-proxy prefixes are supported. An administrator-supplied legacy HTTP account provider requires explicit confirmation of unencrypted sign-in. The plugin never downgrades a failed HTTPS request automatically.

Enterprise credentials are kept on the Host through DSH's native credential-record service. Account passwords, account login tokens, and identity tokens are not persisted. Browser responses contain connection metadata only. Expired enterprise credentials require sign-in again; member status and role changes are checked against the enterprise before protected operations. **Disconnect this device** removes this plugin's saved connection and leaves enterprise membership and existing sessions intact.

**Start a session in the enterprise workspace** creates or reuses a normal local DSH workspace for this enterprise and member. It does not upload sessions, provide remote execution, or grant colleagues access to native conversation logs. The existing local enterprise-management prototype, other plugins, DSH settings, and original upstream source files are independent of this package.

## Install

This is a standalone plugin package, not a replacement DSH build. Install a copy at a persistent path outside temporary development worktrees:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:/absolute/path/to/ipollo-enterprise
```

Enable `@ipollo/dsh-enterprise-connector` in the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles` if the package manager has not enabled it. Native profile recomposition loads the Host and browser faces through `cordis.patch.yml` and the package's `dsh.client` manifest. No upstream DSH file needs editing. Use the existing browser/profile lifecycle to recompose the profile after installation.

In OS, copy the active enterprise URL and join code from the enterprise's member-management settings. In DSH, open **加入企业**, paste that information or enter the fields separately, verify the enterprise, and sign in with the account provider configured for that enterprise. The enterprise endpoint must already be reachable from the employee's device; the desktop-control address and administrator/SSH credentials are not enterprise connection information.

When a custom sidebar is active, open **Plugins → Installed → Join enterprise** and use **Open enterprise connection** to reach the same native panel.

## Verification

```sh
pnpm check
IPOLLO_OS_SOURCE=/absolute/path/to/iPolloOS pnpm check
```

The second command requires OS's `pnpm bundle:enterprise` output. It exercises the real packaged OS enterprise handlers, PGlite migrations, signed identity verification, joining an invited member, directories, persisted connector state, live role changes, and suspended-member rejection. Only the test account provider and native credential-provider fixture are substituted; no user account or existing enterprise data is used.

Set `DSH_NATIVE_PROOF_HOME` to an isolated running DSH profile's home to additionally verify the actual plugin HTTP route, native credential provider, owner-cookie authentication, and native workspace creation. Its `server.log` must contain the authenticated launch URL printed by `dsh --profile enterprise-join --port 0 --no-open`. This path is for disposable test data, not the user's DSH home.

# iPolloWork DSH suite

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

One installable DSH Bundle supplies the iPolloWork skin, a curated native-plugin market, optional iPollo Account sign-in, reusable project agents, and integrated IM channels. DSH owns execution, installed bundles, configuration layers, credentials, and the application launcher. No alternate agent runtime or installer is included.

Enterprise spaces opens with manager-only analytics grouped by department, member or service/model (SKU), over 7, 30 or 90 days. Calls are enterprise-owned service requests, excluding polling and personal services; departments are captured at dispatch. Token coverage is explicit. Project creation and current skill/plugin inventory counts are separate; skill loads and tool calls are reported for linked enterprise projects. `enterpriseUsageReporting` (default true) controls metadata reporting; `enterpriseUsageQueueLimit` (default 200) bounds pending reports. Failed or overflowed reports are not retried and never delay tools, so counts may be incomplete. Arguments, results and credentials are excluded.

## MCP connections

Settings → MCP lists native configured and plugin-registered connections alongside organization grants. Each row's menu offers the actions its source allows. Disconnect keeps configuration and persists across restarts; reconnect reuses DSH's manager. Only user-added configuration entries may be deleted, after confirmation; inherited and plugin-owned entries retain their original ownership. Edit opens DSH's native configuration document. Organization disconnect choices affect this device and account only, retaining the organization's grant. Organization administrators still manage sharing, distribution and revocation in the organization space. MCP credentials stay in the native credential provider.

## Develop

Organization templates and Skills accept custom version labels up to 64 characters. MCP publications label this as the shared configuration version, separate from protocol/server versions. Labels exclude control characters and `/ \\ ? # %`; duplicate versions are rejected. Plugins require the exact published package version. Skill sharing uploads a UTF-8 `.md`/`.markdown` file up to 32 KB through the existing review and grant flow. Update both Suite and the account service before using custom labels.

Node 24.15 or newer is required. In this repository, run `npm run setup:build` from the product root first, then run `npm ci --ignore-scripts --workspaces=false`, `npm run link:workspace`, `npm run check`, and `npm pack` from this directory. The linking command selects matching DSH packages from the ignored official dependency cache; the registry release with the same version may not include this checkout’s native extensions. The package contains its compiled Host and Client entries, styles, brand asset, and the curated catalog. No build script runs during installation.

`dependencies` lists DSH packages, the shared native pi-ai provider library, and `@matrix-org/olm`, whose WASM file is loaded from disk; the build bundles the remaining third-party libraries into `lib`. DSH maps each package name in an enabled bundle's dependency closure to one directory per process. A library name shared with another bundle, such as `yargs` from `qrcode`, would move to that bundle's copy when the suite is disabled, and DSH would then require a restart instead of disabling the suite immediately.

Install a built local checkout using `dsh plugin --profile <profile> add link:/absolute/path/to/ipollowork-dsh-suite`. Start it with the same `dsh --profile <profile>` launcher. Test in a separate profile before enabling in a working profile. Runtime compatibility is deliberately limited to the tested DSH release family. After rebuilding or moving a linked checkout, or replacing it with a packaged release, restart its DSH profile so the Host implementation and bundled catalog use the installed files; refreshing the browser alone does not clear Host module paths. The account-independent `/info` route reports the installed package version. Normal component and bundle switches apply live without a restart.

## Modules

| Module | Owns |
| --- | --- |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | The single native Bundle entry |
| `src/host/index.ts` | Owner-authenticated routes, assets, and service lifetime |
| `src/host/market.ts` | DSH format-1 validation and live installation inventory |
| `src/host/account.ts` | iPollo login and DSH credential records |
| `src/client/theme.tsx` | Reversible palette and native brand slots |
| `src/client/suite.module.css` | All suite visual rules, including shared native/catalog detail dimensions |
| `src/client/market.tsx` | The native Plugins page's additional market tab |
| `src/client/account.tsx` | Account settings, launcher, and shared account state |
| `src/host/agents.ts` | Agent definitions, native presets, and delegation |
| `src/host/agent-runtime.ts` | Preset instructions, selected Skills, and project memory |
| `src/client/agents.tsx` | Agent library, configuration, and project memory editor |

## Configuration

Override the `ipollowork-suite` row's `config` in the profile patch. Fields are `accountOrigin` (defaults to iPolloWork Cloud), `catalogPath` (the bundled catalog by default), `requestTimeoutMs` (20000), `maxResponseBytes` (1048576), and `theme`, `market`, `account` (all true). Account services require HTTPS; HTTP is accepted only for loopback development. Changing the account origin never reuses another origin's saved credential.

Edit `catalog/index.json` to curate the market. It keeps DSH format 1. Design (including PPT) and Video appear first in the default catalog under Creative. Their checked tarballs ship in `catalog/packages/` in the suite and desktop builds; `catalog/bundled-releases.json` pins their versions and SHA-256 hashes. For this default catalog only, the Host verifies those files, copies them atomically into a retained content-addressed cache under DSH home, and supplies local `file:` specs to DSH's existing installer. The saved install source therefore survives suite upgrades or removal. No unpublished npm version is needed, and showing a card does not install or enable its plugin. Replace the tarballs and their checksum records together when updating a release. Custom `catalogPath` indexes retain their declared native npm/Git sources.

Installed state always comes from DSH. The market opens DSH's existing install dialog and installed-bundle detail page. It never downloads or executes packages itself. The Enterprise tab reports that no enterprise catalog is connected.

With `theme` enabled, the skin gives DSH iPolloWork's identity. Before any client code loads, the served page already carries the iPolloWork title, tab icon, home-screen icon and install manifest, and DSH's boot page shows the iPolloWork mark and name; the files come from the anonymous `/ipollowork-suite/brand/` route. In the client, the sidebar and the running status show the iPolloWork mark in place of DSH's whale; the home headline follows the original iPolloWork home, with the iPollo Work wordmark above the title "Turn ideas into outcomes", left-aligned with the composer over a soft blue and gold glow; and session titles end in iPolloWork. The palette is black and white with one blue accent (`#2563eb`, `#7aa2ff` in dark): primary actions, including Send, are black, the composer has a blue-to-gold edge, and surfaces use hairlines, light shadows and at most 12px blur. Model and provider names such as DeepSeek stay unchanged, and DSH's own technical messages that mention DSH cannot be overridden from a plugin.

The skin presents native composer references as the original iPolloWork selection chips: a compact rounded label with a persistent close button, light and dark palettes, and ellipsis for long labels. Styling is scoped to the enabled suite; DSH still owns reference data, keyboard editing, removal, and context serialization.

The market uses compact rows. Installed and DSH-provided entries open DSH's existing detail page directly. Uninstalled entries use one `PluginDetailPage` template in `market.tsx`: one back button, a 48px package icon, package summary, components, and release information below. The suite hides the native list header only while its own catalog detail is open, using DSH's data attributes. Search and category selection remain when returning from catalog details. Layouts support light and dark themes and narrow screens. All visual rules live in `suite.module.css`; native and catalog details share icon/title dimension variables. DSH does not currently export a common page component for installed and uninstalled entries, so this suite does not import or copy its private page implementations.

## Official integration

The suite uses native profile patches to replace account onboarding, which persists through DSH settings. The official plugin-manager provider stays mounted during installation, activation and deactivation, retaining its generated Remote definitions. Users can disable or remove this third-party bundle through the official manager. Sharing contributes its own header dialog and audience slot while all share operations use the official `liveshareShares` Remote. These are product UI and policy extensions; no official source edits or separate Agent loop are required.

For the activation regression, set `IPOLLO_LIFECYCLE_OWNER_FILE` to a private JSON file containing `origin` and `cookie` for a disposable official Web profile with the built suite installed, then run `node --test tests/bundle-lifecycle.test.mjs`. The test disables and enables the suite twice and leaves it enabled. Version 0.1.22 removes the previous manager replacement; after installing it over 0.1.21, restart the Host to restore the official manager and its Remote definitions.

The official 0.2.2-rc.3 desktop release owns authentication inside Connection; the pinned source build exposes a separate authentication service. The suite mounts under that service when present and otherwise delegates to the release's existing Connection. It creates no verifier and changes no admission policy. Both runtimes require authenticated requests.

## Account behavior

Account-channel defaults use the official model catalog, credential metadata and `agentDefaultModel.saveSelection()` services. A configured personal API key or an existing account-channel selection is retained. The suite does not extend `SessionController.initializeDefaultModel()`.

Local work and browsing the public catalog require no iPollo login. The account page registers with an email and a password of at least 10 characters; the initial display name comes from the email’s local part. Account connection status does not imply that official services are configured; service availability is shown in Service connections. An empty service catalog is not a sign-in failure. Registration uses `/api/auth/sign-up/email` and signs in with the returned session. Email/password login uses the existing Better Auth `/api/auth/sign-in/email` and `/api/auth/get-session` endpoints. Tokens persist only in DSH's credential provider. Passwords are discarded after each request. `/api/v1/me/summary` supplies optional points; an unavailable balance is displayed as unavailable, never zero. Disconnect removes this suite's local token; it neither deletes the account nor changes DSH's other model-provider credentials.

The bundle replaces the built-in DeepSeek account UI and its notification UI through two ordinary profile overrides; the DeepSeek account service and other model-provider credentials remain intact. Disabling the bundle removes these overrides. With `account: false`, the suite presents no account UI.

The account page shows identity, available credits and membership, daily and weekly consumption, and seven days of usage in one column of setting rows, like DSH's own settings pages; plans open in a dialog. Account data, orders and payments belong to this standalone service. Checkout is offered only for configured payment channels and enabled plans.

The suite uses provider model capacities without a separate product output limit. A committed truncated account-model response with no pending tool calls or queued human input continues through the native agent inbox. Continuation text is recorded as `ipollowork-output-continuation`; the client suppresses the protocol warning row. Unloading removes listeners and unclaimed continuation messages, while preserving user messages and recorded output.

## Limits

The agent module registers discovery, native delegation, and project-memory tools. Account secrets and market administration are not injected into a conversation. In the dedicated desktop, a native pre-execution policy refuses direct `plugin_manager` mutations of the built-in components while preserving reads and management of other plugins. The public plugin adds no such restriction. This is not tamper protection: shell/file access can bypass that tool, and DSH's built-in protected-package list does not automatically protect arbitrary third-party bundles. An administrator-managed installation still requires a generic management-authorization extension plus operating-system isolation if agents or third-party Host plugins can write the installation. Do not use hiding UI or this package's presence as an enterprise security boundary.

Existing theme plugins can override the same tokens. Use one product skin at a time. Removing the suite retracts its slots, stylesheet, and palette without deleting account or session data. Account sign-in is implemented against the checked-in iPollo service protocol; production login requires a real account and live-service validation. Native installer branding, enterprise catalog distribution, payment processing, and importing old iPolloWork package formats are outside this version.

The existing iPolloWork logo is included as the product brand asset. Third-party plugins retain their own authorship and licenses.

## Reusable project agents

The suite's **Agents / 智能体** navigation shows reusable assistants with a direct **Start chat** action. Creation asks for a name and work instructions; Skills and existing DSH services are optional, collapsed choices. An optional avatar accepts PNG, JPEG or WebP up to 5 MB; the browser center-crops and reduces it to a 256-pixel square before saving. Only the compact raster is retained in native storage. Existing assistants without an image keep their text avatar, and images never enter model inputs. Pick a project when starting a conversation or opening project memory, not when creating the assistant. The same definition can be used by several projects; conversations and memory remain separate. Selected Skills retain their resource references; the Standard composition's existing Skills remain available.

`ipollo_list_agents` discovers enabled agents and `ipollo_delegate` delegates through the native spawn backend. Each child gets its selected preset, so one main Agent can coordinate different specialists without switching its own preset. The existing four presets are not edited. The service picker reads DSH's existing MCP manager and reuses its connections and credentials; it does not create another server or account record. Service selection restricts inherited MCP tools for that assistant and follows live tool registration changes. This is tool visibility, not filesystem or tenant isolation. Older saved dedicated MCP connections remain usable, but new connections are configured in DSH's service settings. The suite's account sign-in is independent of assistant creation.

The model selector defaults to the current native model: a new top-level conversation uses DSH’s global default, and a delegated assistant inherits its parent’s model. An explicit choice applies to newly created instances of that assistant, including delegated children, using native durable model selection. It does not update DSH’s global default or overwrite a model already selected in an existing conversation. Choices come from the native model catalog and use existing provider credentials.

The optional `ipollowork-agents` component has configurable agent and memory limits and an MCP startup timeout. Turning off the suite removes its UI and new-task capabilities while retaining saved data. The fea

rovider settings. Storage credentials and account tokens never enter the generated page.

For the keyless output-archive smoke, point the isolated profile at a disposable PostgreSQL service, compile `tests/native-fixture.ts` and load `tests/native.patch.yml`, then run `IPOLLO_ARCHIVE_QA_URL=<private-owner-url> node --import tsx --test tests/project-archive-native.test.ts`. It verifies that native presentation stays local, explicit output upload, an authorized download over 24 MiB and input exclusion. The expected result stays under `tests/expected`.

Organization-space project creation is fixed to the selected organization; personal creation remains in the global directory flow. Organization administration has no shared-conversation tab or list of unassigned personal projects. Native conversation sharing remains on each conversation.

Service records carry a stable `category` (`language`, `image`, `video`, `audio`, `embedding`, `tool`) and `vendor`; model entries retain their own category. Only language models with token limits register in the native chat selector. Organization service lists and department grants use these categories, including tool services. Non-chat organization connections require explicit allowed API routes; existing connections keep their routes and classification when edited.

Official media calls select a service by its allowed route and the requested model. This lets image generation and speech share a provider endpoint and key without selecting the wrong category. Regional provider origins remain owned by the account service. Disabling the suite or choosing native personal credentials removes official routing.

The `dedicatedDesktop` deployment option reuses the native welcome, credit, purpose and process pages with the iPolloWork account. The native account page provides email/password sign-in and registration with a display name and a password of at least 10 characters. API-key setup remains available. The desktop distribution embeds this bundle and its QR-code dependency; it does not require an npm installation at first launch.

Suite 0.1.10 requires DSH 0.2.2-rc.3 or later in the 0.2.2 release line. Its HTTP routes use the native Connection admission service, including the Host/Origin checks and credential verification.

Registered account model channels display their backend names under iPolloWork. Login selects an available account channel when no personal provider key is configured; an existing selected account channel is retained. Users can add and choose personal API-key providers through the native Models settings. Account inference uses a private local gateway token, and insufficient points produce an account-quota failure rather than a key error.

The embedded IM runtime uses Cordis’s public root-context symbol. Bundled Design and Video are imported byte-for-byte from their checked native source builds. Run `node scripts/prepare-studio-releases.mjs <archive-directory> <version>` to update both archives and the catalog together; each bundle declares its own rc.3 authentication dependency.

Account balances refresh when the application regains focus or becomes visible. Compatible DeepSeek and Bailian chat models inherit the installed provider catalog’s reasoning levels and request dialect; unknown models remain selectable without invented reasoning levels.

Account and payment layouts contain their box sizing within the native settings panel. The suite resolves DSH services from the host through peer dependencies; installing it does not replace the host runtime packages.

## HTTP capabilities

The native `ipollo_capabilities`, `ipollo_capability_describe`, `ipollo_capability_invoke` and `ipollo_capability_task` tools discover and call the [capability HTTP API](../../services/ipollowork/docs/capabilities.md). Detailed inputs load on demand; requests reuse native call identities for idempotency, preserve cancellation and respect read-only sessions. These tools do not expose account or provider keys.

## App data

The Data page, the `app_data` model tool and the `ipolloData` plugin service give plugins, sites and apps a record store in the account service without a database of their own. See [App data](docs/app-data.md).

Design publication uses a stable workspace-and-file identity. Repeated publishing updates the same public URL, while uploads remain private until the complete revision is ready. The account service must provide schema 8 and the publication-site lookup endpoint.

## Sandbox plugins

Alibaba Agent Sandbox ships as an optional, disabled-by-default plugin component. It uses the official DSH tool and lifecycle APIs. See [configuration, persistence requirements and verification limits](docs/sandbox-plugins.md).

Cloud projects: [setup, lifecycle and validation limits](docs/cloud-projects.md).



Office onboarding and skipping setup retain the full agent preset list. Compact chat changes transcript and usage presentation without disabling coding view. Existing installations can enable coding view in Settings to restore PTC and Minimal modes.

Official vision model channels resolve DSH’s durable attachment service at request time for both user images and tool-result screenshots. They preserve the native attachment and filesystem mapping rather than creating a separate image store.

Source and desktop profile setup permits the pinned esbuild and sharp builds used by Studio, while skipping ONNX postinstall downloads: Studio uses the CPU provider already included in the package. Existing operator build policies are retained. First installation still needs npm dependencies; subsequent installs reuse the package-manager cache.

Organization model connections support `shared` (default) and `member` credential modes. In member mode each authorized member saves their own key from **My API key**; it is encrypted in the account service, never returned by list APIs, and requires a project belonging to the organization at execution. Changing the endpoint or credential mode clears member keys. Removing a member or service clears its corresponding keys. Signing out disconnects the local account but preserves server-side member keys; other devices are not modified.

## Curated market administration

The existing market shows **Add plugin** only after `/api/v1/market/manage` confirms the signed-in account has the platform `admin` role. Enterprise owner/admin roles do not grant permission to publish to the public market. Every write is checked again by the account service. Paste a public GitHub repository URL, npm package name or npm package page into the form. The unmodified official DSH reference generator reads names, localized descriptions, icons, release versions and compatibility without executing plugin code. Choose a plugin when a repository contains several, preview its compatible pinned release, then confirm. Advanced settings contain optional display text, category and npm registry overrides. It does not copy, install, execute or audit third-party code. Duplicate package names are refused; existing bundled entries keep precedence.

New references are stored centrally in the account service's existing encrypted settings, with serialized writes and transactional audit records; no new database table is needed. `/api/market/catalog` exposes only the bounded public references. The suite merges these with the shipped catalog. If the service is unavailable or has not been upgraded, shipped plugins remain browsable and the add button stays hidden. Deploy both packages to enable administration; no deployment is performed by a local build.

Public-source discovery runs in a bounded child process from the pinned official generator bundled at build time; it is not a second Agent runtime. A custom HTTPS npm installation registry may be supplied in advanced settings. Mainland/overseas automatic routing and artifact mirroring are a separate deployment step: mirror only reviewed versions and permitted artifacts, verify content digests, then route to equivalent sources. No public proxy, automatic mirror or geographic detection is enabled by this form. Existing user pages and installation dialogs are unchanged.

# iPolloWork DSH 套件

[English](README.md) | 中文

一个可安装的 DSH Bundle 提供 iPolloWork 皮肤、人工维护的原生插件市场、可选的 iPollo Account 登录、可复用的项目 agent（智能体）以及集成的 IM 通道。执行、已安装 Bundle、配置层、凭据和应用启动均由 DSH 管理。套件不包含其他 agent 运行时或安装器。

组织空间默认打开管理员数据分析，可按部门、成员或服务/模型（SKU）查看近 7、30、90 天记录。调用仅含企业所属服务请求，不含轮询和个人服务；部门按发起调用时归属记录。页面标明 Token 采集覆盖率，并独立展示新增项目和当前技能、插件资源数量；企业关联项目可上报技能加载与工具调用次数。`enterpriseUsageReporting`（默认 true）控制名称与结果状态上报，`enterpriseUsageQueueLimit`（默认 200）限制排队数量。失败或队列溢出的记录不重试、不阻塞工具，统计可能不完整；不上传参数、结果正文和凭据。

## MCP 连接

设置 → MCP 统一列出原生配置、插件注册及组织下发的连接。每行的更多菜单按来源提供操作：断开保留配置并在重启后保持，连接复用 DSH 原生管理器；仅用户自行添加的配置允许二次确认后删除，继承配置和插件条目保持原有管理权。编辑打开 DSH 原生配置文件。组织 MCP 的断开选择仅影响本机当前账号，保留组织授权；共享、下发和撤回继续由管理员在组织空间操作。MCP 密钥仍由原生凭据提供方管理。

## 开发

组织模板和 Skill 支持最多 64 字符的自定义版本标识；MCP 发布表单称其为“共享配置版本”，独立于协议和服务端软件版本。标识排除控制字符及 `/ \\ ? # %`，重复版本会被拒绝；插件须填写第三方包已发布的准确版本。Skill 共享通过上传最多 32 KB 的 UTF-8 `.md`/`.markdown` 文件提交，沿用现有审核和授权流程。使用自定义标识前需同时更新 Suite 与账户服务。

需要 Node 24.15 或更新版本。在本仓库中先在产品根目录执行 `npm run setup:build`，再从本目录执行 `npm ci --ignore-scripts --workspaces=false`、`npm run link:workspace`、`npm run check` 和 `npm pack`。链接命令使用版本匹配的本地 DSH 包；同版本的注册表发行包可能尚未包含本工作区的原生扩展。包内包含编译后的 Host、Client、样式、品牌资源和精选目录，安装时不运行构建脚本。

`dependencies` 声明 DSH 软件包、共享的原生 pi-ai 提供方库和 `@matrix-org/olm`；后者的 WASM 文件从磁盘加载。其余第三方库在构建时打包进 `lib`。DSH 在每个进程内将已启用 Bundle 的依赖闭包中的每个包名映射到一个目录。如果与其他 Bundle 共享库名，例如 `qrcode` 引入的 `yargs`，停用套件时该库会切换到另一个 Bundle 的副本，DSH 因而会要求重启，而不能立即停用套件。

使用 `dsh plugin --profile <profile> add link:/absolute/path/to/ipollowork-dsh-suite` 安装构建后的本地目录，再通过同一个 `dsh --profile <profile>` 启动器启动。先在独立 profile 中测试，再在工作 profile 中启用。运行时兼容范围限定为已测试的 DSH 版本系列。重新构建或移动链接目录，或将其替换为发布包后，重启对应 DSH profile，使 Host 实现与内置目录使用已安装文件；仅刷新浏览器不会清除 Host 模块路径。不依赖账号登录的 `/info` 路由报告已安装的软件包版本。正常的组件和 Bundle 开关会即时生效，无需重启。

## 配置

在 profile 补丁中覆盖 `ipollowork-suite` 行的 `config`。字段包括 `accountOrigin`（默认使用 iPolloWork 云服务）、`catalogPath`（默认使用内置目录）、`requestTimeoutMs`（20000）、`maxResponseBytes`（1048576），以及 `theme`、`market`、`account`（均为 true）。账号服务必须使用 HTTPS 来源；HTTP 仅供回环地址开发使用。切换账号服务来源时，不会复用其他来源已保存的凭据。

编辑 `catalog/index.json` 维护市场，其格式保持为 DSH format 1。默认目录的 Creative 分类首先显示 Design（包含 PPT）和 Video。套件和桌面构建在 `catalog/packages/` 中携带经过校验的安装包，`catalog/bundled-releases.json` 固定其版本与 SHA-256 哈希。仅对该默认目录，Host 会校验文件，将其原子复制到 DSH home 中按内容寻址的持久缓存，并向 DSH 现有安装器提供本地 `file:` 规格。保存的安装来源因此能够在套件升级或移除后继续使用，不需要未发布的 npm 版本；显示卡片不会安装或启用插件。更新版本时同时替换压缩包与校验记录。自定义 `catalogPath` 索引保留声明的原生 npm/Git 来源。

安装状态始终来自 DSH。市场打开 DSH 现有的安装对话框和已安装 Bundle 详情页，不自行下载或执行软件包。企业标签页会说明当前没有连接企业目录。

启用 `theme` 后，皮肤为 DSH 提供 iPolloWork 品牌。客户端代码加载前，页面已带有 iPolloWork 标题、标签页图标、主屏幕图标和安装清单，DSH 启动页显示 iPolloWork 标志和名称，这些文件由免登录的 `/ipollowork-suite/brand/` 路由提供。客户端中，侧栏和运行状态以 iPolloWork 标志替换 DSH 的鲸鱼图案；首页标题沿用原版 iPolloWork 首页，在蓝色与金色的柔光上与输入框左对齐，显示 iPollo Work 字标和标题“把想法变成成果”；会话标题以 iPolloWork 结尾。配色以黑白为主，只使用一种蓝色强调色（浅色 `#2563eb`，深色 `#7aa2ff`）：包括发送按钮在内的主操作为黑色，输入框带蓝到金的渐变边，界面使用细线、浅阴影和不超过 12px 的模糊。DeepSeek 等模型和服务商名称保持不变；DSH 自身提到 DSH 的技术提示无法由插件覆盖。

皮肤将原生输入框引用显示为原版 iPolloWork 的选中标签：紧凑的圆角标签、始终可用的关闭按钮、明暗调色板，以及长标签省略显示。样式仅在套件启用时生效；引用数据、键盘编辑、移除和上下文序列化仍由 DSH 管理。

市场使用紧凑列表。已安装条目和 DSH 自带条目直接打开现有 DSH 详情页。未安装条目使用 `market.tsx` 中统一的 `PluginDetailPage` 模板：一个返回按钮、48px 包图标，下方依次展示包简介、组件和版本信息。套件仅在自己的目录详情打开时，通过 DSH 数据属性隐藏原生列表标题；返回时保留搜索和分类选择。布局支持明暗主题与窄屏。所有视觉规则集中在 `suite.module.css`，原生与目录详情共享图标和标题的尺寸变量。DSH 当前未导出可供已安装和未安装条目共用的页面组件，因此套件不导入或复制其私有页面实现。

## 官方集成

套件通过原生 profile patch 替换账户引导，首次引导通过 DSH settings 持久化。安装、启用和停用期间始终保留官方插件管理 provider 及其生成的 Remote 定义。用户可通过官方管理器停用或移除这个第三方套件。分享提供自己的会话顶部对话框与受众插槽，所有分享操作仍调用官方 `liveshareShares` Remote。这些是产品界面与策略扩展，无需修改官方源码或另建 Agent 循环。

启停回归测试使用已安装构建后套件的独立官方 Web profile。将该测试环境的 `origin` 和 `cookie` 写入私有 JSON 文件，以 `IPOLLO_LIFECYCLE_OWNER_FILE` 指向它，再执行 `node --test tests/bundle-lifecycle.test.mjs`。测试会两次停用并启用套件，最终保持启用。0.1.22 移除了旧的管理器替换；从 0.1.21 更新后，需要重启 Host，以恢复官方管理器及其 Remote 定义。

官方 0.2.2-rc.3 桌面发行包在 Connection 内管理认证，固定源码构建则导出独立认证服务。插件按宿主实际导出的 API 声明依赖，沿用现有认证，不创建校验器、不改变准入规则。两种运行时都要求请求经过认证。

## 账号行为

账号渠道默认模型通过官方模型目录、凭据元数据和 `agentDefaultModel.saveSelection()` 服务选择。已配置个人 API Key 或已选账号渠道时保留现有选择。套件不扩展 `SessionController.initializeDefaultModel()`。

本地工作和浏览公开目录不需要 iPollo 登录。账号页通过邮箱和至少 10 位密码直接注册，初始显示名称取自邮箱的本地部分。账号已连接不表示官方服务已配置，服务可用状态在服务连接页展示；空服务目录不表示登录失败。注册调用 `/api/auth/sign-up/email`，并使用返回的会话登录；邮箱密码登录使用现有 Better Auth 的 `/api/auth/sign-in/email` 与 `/api/auth/get-session`。令牌仅保存在 DSH 凭据提供方中，每次请求后丢弃密码。`/api/v1/me/summary` 提供可选的积分信息；余额不可用时显示不可用，不显示为零。断开连接仅移除套件的本地令牌，不删除账号，也不改变 DSH 其他模型提供方的凭据。

Bundle 通过两项普通 profile 覆盖替换内置 DeepSeek 账号及其通知界面；DeepSeek 账号服务与其他模型提供方凭据保持不变。停用 Bundle 会撤销这些覆盖。设置 `account: false` 时，套件不显示账号界面。

账号页以与 DSH 设置页一致的单列设置行展示身份、可用积分与会员、当日与本周消耗，以及近七天用量；套餐在弹窗中选择。账号、订单和支付由当前独立服务处理。仅已启用的套餐和已配置的支付渠道提供购买入口。

套件使用供应商公布的模型容量，不另设产品级单次输出上限。官方账号模型的已保存响应被截断、且没有待处理工具调用或用户输入时，通过原生 agent 收件箱继续任务。续接文本以 `ipollowork-output-continuation` 来源记录；客户端不展示协议警告行。卸载会移除监听器和尚未接收的续接消息，保留用户消息和已保存输出。

## 限制

Agent 模块注册发现、原生委派和项目记忆工具。账号密钥与市场管理不会注入会话。专属客户端通过原生执行前策略阻止 `plugin_manager` 修改内置组件，同时保留读取与管理其他插件的能力。公共插件不添加该限制。这不是防篡改保护：shell/文件访问可以绕过该工具，DSH 的内置受保护包名单也不会自动保护任意第三方 Bundle。如果 agent 或第三方 Host 插件能够写入安装目录，管理员管理的安装仍需要通用管理授权扩展和操作系统隔离。不能把隐藏界面或安装本软件包视为企业安全边界。

现有主题插件可能覆盖相同的变量，一次使用一个产品皮肤。移除套件会撤销其 slot、样式表和调色板，不会删除账号或会话数据。账号登录基于仓库中的 iPollo 服务协议实现；生产登录需要真实账号及在线服务验证。原生安装器品牌替换、企业目录分发、支付处理和导入旧版 iPolloWork 包格式不在本版本范围内。

现有 iPolloWork 标志作为产品品牌资源随包提供。第三方插件保留各自的作者信息和许可证。

## 可复用的项目 agent

套件的 **Agents / 智能体** 导航展示可复用助手，并提供直接 **Start chat** 的操作。创建时填写名称和工作指令；Skills 与现有 DSH 服务作为可选的折叠选项。可选头像支持最大 5 MB 的 PNG、JPEG 或 WebP；浏览器先居中裁剪为 256 像素方形图片再保存，原生存储仅保留压缩后的栅格图片。没有图片的现有助手继续使用文字头像，图片不会进入模型输入。项目在开始会话或打开项目记忆时选择，不在创建助手时绑定。同一定义可用于多个项目，会话和记忆彼此隔离。所选 Skills 保留资源引用，Standard 组合中现有的 Skills 仍然可用。

`ipollo_list_agents` 发现已启用的 agent，`ipollo_delegate` 通过原生 spawn 后端委派任务。每个子任务使用所选预设，主 Agent 因而可以协调不同专家而不切换自身预设。现有四个预设不会修改。服务选择器读取 DSH 现有 MCP 管理器，复用其连接与凭据，不创建另一个服务器或账号记录。服务选择限制该助手继承的 MCP 工具，并跟随实时工具注册变化。这是工具可见性控制，不是文件系统或租户隔离。旧版保存的专用 MCP 连接仍可使用，新连接在 DSH 服务设置中配置。套件账号登录与创建助手相互独立。

模型选择器默认使用当前原生模型：新的顶层会话使用 DSH 全局默认模型，委派助手继承父级模型。显式选择通过原生持久模型选择机制作用于该助手之后创建的实例，包括委派子任务；不会修改 DSH 全局默认值，也不会覆盖已有会话中已选择的模型。可选模型来自原生模型目录，使用现有提供方凭据。

可选的 `ipollowork-agents` 组件支持配置 agent 和记忆数量限制，以及 MCP 启动超时。停用套件移除其界面和新任务能力，已保存数据保留。该能力位于现有软件包中，不另设套件或独立应用。

运行 `npm run check` 执行单元检查。原生验证时，启动加载本 Bundle 和 `tests/native.patch.yml` 的临时 DSH profile（使用已打包启动器时先将测试 fixture（测试前置数据）编译为 JavaScript），然后设置 `IPOLLO_QA_URL` 为所有者 URL，再运行 `npx tsx --test tests/native.test.ts`。该无密钥测试验证真实模型请求输入、不同子任务预设、项目记忆隔离和认证后的 MCP 启动。

## 集成消息通道

左侧工作区导航使用原生工作区和会话列表，不再单独显示“总助手”快捷入口。已有总助手会话保留预设和历史；消息连接继续使用 `ipollo-coordinator`。

每个新消息连接都会启动原生 `ipollo-coordinator` 会话，包括扫码和自动连接。总助手可以直接工作、通过 `ipollo_delegate` 使用保存的专家，或通过 `ipollo_dispatch` 创建任务专用的临时工作者。临时工作者使用原生 Standard 预设并继承总助手模型；保存的专家保留自己的指令、Skills、服务选择和可选模型。IM 请求等待原生任务树完成后返回总助手汇总的回答。

每个平台连接只授权一次，专家无需单独扫码。不同聊天保留各自的原生 Session，所选项目/工作区设置仍然生效。共享的是全局协调器定义，不是聊天历史。套件不会增加对未披露群消息的访问，也不会合并不同通道的历史。

现有已绑定会话保留预设和历史。升级后发送 `/new`，以总助手开始新会话。IM 预设选择器说明这一固定入口；在 **Agents** 中管理专家。旧版保存的机器人预设选择留在磁盘上，不会覆盖。见[升级说明](docs/upgrades/main-assistant.md)。

`ipollowork-im` 组件在套件中嵌入 MIT 许可的 DSH IM 适配器。其设置与可选侧栏页面属于 iPolloWork；人工维护的市场不再提供重复的独立 IM 安装。源码及本地修改记录于 [vendor/dsh-im/README.md](vendor/dsh-im/README.md)。

从 `@xmanrui/dsh-im` 切换前，先在 DSH 原生插件管理器中停用该 Bundle，再启用本套件。复用现有通道设置与原生凭据引用。为防止机器人重复回复，不允许同时启用二者。停用套件时，通道控制器与界面随原生插件生命周期移除，已保存配置保留。切换 Bundle 后，如果原生热重载仍显示旧 Client，请刷新页面。不会修改 DSH 核心软件包或原始预设。

图片进入正常的原生图片处理流程。无视觉能力的模型收到保留的图片文件和明确限制说明，不会声称看过图片。收到的文件和音频成为原生会话附件。钉钉识别文本与企微语音转写会被保留。飞书和企微应用录音可以使用已配置的原生语音提供方；除非输入已经是标准 16 kHz 单声道 PCM WAV，否则格式转换需要 `ffmpeg`。缺少或失败的转写会保留录音及其状态。企微智能机器人回调通常仅提供文字；只有平台提供下载引用时才能保存原录音。

结果媒体继续使用现有 `dsh_im_return_file` 通道发送工具。普通 Markdown 中的本地文件路径不等于媒体上传。继承的适配器选择支持的图片或文件消息并报告发送失败；平台专用的原生语音气泡仍取决于各适配器支持情况。

运行 `npm run check`、`npm run test:im-upstream` 和 `npm run pack:check`。无密钥原生媒体回放时，使用 esbuild 将 `tests/im-native-fixture.mjs` 编译为临时 fixture（旁边复制 `tests/fixtures/avatar.png`），让 `tests/im-native.patch.yml` 指向该文件，通过原生 `dsh web` profile 启动，再设置 `IPOLLO_IM_QA_URL`，运行 `node --import tsx --test tests/im-native.test.mjs`。测试使用本地通道响应与 mock 模型，不使用真实机器人凭据。

### 连接机器人后的菜单

飞书与 Telegram 保留原生命令菜单注册。飞书面板不可用时，第一条获得授权的私聊消息会打开现有菜单卡片。钉钉与 QQ 在第一条获得授权的私聊消息中显示现有交互菜单；企微智能机器人在首次进入聊天事件时展示紧凑欢迎卡片，若没有进入事件，则在首次私聊消息时展示。微信使用文字指南。原始消息仍会处理，群聊不会收到主动引导。

企微自建应用自动创建包含 Chat、Agents 和 Actions 的原生底部菜单。点击事件映射到现有命令，保留访问检查。管理员已有菜单保持不变；如果无法注册，则改为在首次进入或首次获得授权的消息中显示文字指南。

每个通道第一版状态中的可选 `menuIntroductions` 字段，在发送前记录各会话已尝试的引导，并在重启后保留。发送结果不确定或失败时，不会自动重试；用户仍可显式使用 `/menu` 或 `/help`。这不增加 DSH Session 事件或持久化类型。平台菜单与卡片布局仍需要在真实移动客户端验收，自动检查使用已认证的回调样本和 mock 平台 API。

## 组织项目

组织页面管理部门、文件包、Skills 和组织模型，权限规则见[组织资源](docs/enterprise-assets.md)。需要 PostgreSQL 账号服务，配置见[服务说明](../../services/ipollowork/README.zh.md)。

通过原生目录表单创建个人或组织项目。项目可按成员或部门授予查看、参与、维护权限，每次请求都检查当前成员关系。维护者管理权限并接纳贡献，本地工作仍在所选目录中。

项目包含概览、文件、项目记忆和改动。概览围绕参与者和实际贡献数量，文件显示输出版本、作者和容量，支持下载及手动上传。原生 `present` 默认不上传文件，不上传输入文件或完整本地 Session。参与者选择需上传的输出，维护者管理上传权限。云端到期不删除本地文件，规则见[存储说明](../../services/ipollowork/docs/storage.md)。

关联文件只包含服务来源和项目 ID。每轮模型开始前重新授权并读取当前项目记忆，撤销访问后不会复用旧上下文。`ipollo_project_memory` 可读取、提交提炼知识，或由维护者携带版本和贡献 ID 明确合并。完整摘要最多 8,000 字符、两级标题，版本冲突保留草稿。后台不运行模型，不需要 Git，也不批量同步本地状态。

打开分享时，通过原生 PKCE 流程接入当前账号；已校验的账号直接复用，无需再次登录或填写分享服务地址。分享沿用原生弹窗、查看器、会话权限与 fork 开关，可选择任何获得链接的人，或组织及其部门。成员变化实时影响组织分享；停用套件移除接收范围扩展和账号准备钩子。开放链接允许匿名访问，分享电脑必须保持在线。会话标题和菜单保留分享入口，未登录用户先连接账号。

历史快照和旧结果仍可读取，旧快照、评论和结果写入返回 HTTP 410。升级账号服务后再安装套件，详见[升级说明](docs/upgrades/2026-11-14-project-spaces.md)。

原生中继测试使用隔离服务和配置，将 `IPOLLO_QA_URL`、`IPOLLO_RELAY_ORIGIN`、`IPOLLO_RELAY_TEST_PASSWORD` 指向测试实例后执行 `node --import tsx --test tests/liveshare-native.test.ts`。不要对工作配置运行该测试。

项目关联兼容官方账号域名 `https://work.ipollo.net` 与 `https://cloud.ipollo.net` 的迁移。请求仍发送到配置中的服务并接受当前项目权限校验，其他部署继续隔离；此兼容不会授予不存在或无权访问的云项目权限。

套件输出上传配置为 `uploadTimeoutMs`（300,000）和 `maxArtifactBytes`（536,870,912）。部署专用的 `automaticOutputArchive` 默认为 false；启用后，关联项目会在具备上传权限时流式归档原生展示的完成输出，`archiveHistoryLimit`（500）限制上传记录数量。内存队列不保留完整 Session 对象；队列满时 Host 提示从项目页上传本地文件。完成记录有数量上限，后端请求 ID 保证重放不会创建重复版本。

可选的 Host 服务还可发布在 Design 中选定的文件集。它使用当前账号流式上传文件，在已有项目关联时保留项目归属，并在服务的独立浏览来源打开完整发布。独立安装的 Design 仍使用自己的存储服务设置。存储密钥和账号令牌不会进入生成的页面。

输出归档的无 Key 测试使用隔离 PostgreSQL 服务和配置，编译 `tests/native-fixture.ts` 并加载 `tests/native.patch.yml`，然后运行 `IPOLLO_ARCHIVE_QA_URL=<private-owner-url> node --import tsx --test tests/project-archive-native.test.ts`。它验证原生展示保留在本地、明确选择输出后上传、超过 24 MiB 的授权下载和输入排除。预期结果保存在 `tests/expected`。

从组织空间创建项目时，归属固定为当前组织；个人创建保留在全局目录入口。组织后台不展示共享会话页签或未归属的个人项目，原生会话分享仍在对应会话中操作。

服务记录包含稳定的 `category`（`language`、`image`、`video`、`audio`、`embedding`、`tool`）和 `vendor`，各模型也保留自己的类别。只有具备 Token 上限的语言模型进入原生对话模型选择器。组织服务列表和部门授权按这些类别展示，包括工具服务。非对话组织服务须明确配置允许的接口路径，编辑已有连接会保留其路径与分类。

官方媒体调用根据允许的接口路径和请求模型选择服务，因此图像生成与语音可以共用服务商接口和 Key，不会选错类别。服务商地域域名由账号服务管理；关闭套件或改用原生个人凭据后，官方路由随即移除。

部署选项 `dedicatedDesktop` 使用 iPolloWork 账号复用原有欢迎、额度、用途和工作过程引导页面，仍保留 API Key 设置入口。桌面发行包内置本套件及二维码依赖，首次启动无需从 npm 安装。

应用重新获得焦点或恢复可见时会刷新账户余额。兼容的 DeepSeek 和百炼聊天模型沿用已安装提供方目录中的推理等级及请求格式；未知模型仍可选择，但不会虚构推理等级。

账户与支付布局在原生设置面板内管理盒模型尺寸。套件通过 peer dependencies 使用宿主提供的 DSH 服务；安装套件不会替换宿主运行时包。

内置 IM 使用 Cordis 的公开根上下文标识。Design 和 Video 从其已验证的原生源码构建原样导入。运行 `node scripts/prepare-studio-releases.mjs <archive-directory> <version>` 同步更新两个压缩包及目录；各插件自行声明 rc.3 鉴权依赖。

## HTTP 能力

原生工具 `ipollo_capabilities`、`ipollo_capability_describe`、`ipollo_capability_invoke` 和 `ipollo_capability_task` 发现并调用[能力 HTTP API](../../services/ipollowork/docs/capabilities.md)。详细参数按需加载，请求复用原生调用标识以防重复扣费，并传递取消信号、遵守只读会话限制；工具不暴露账号或供应商 Key。

“数据”页面、模型工具 `app_data` 和插件服务 `ipolloData` 让插件、网站和应用把记录存进账号服务，无需自建数据库。详见[应用数据](docs/app-data.md)。

Design 发布会按工作区和文件复用原公开地址。新版本完整上传后才替换线上内容；上传失败保留旧页面。该能力需要账户服务的数据库版本 8 或更高版本。

阿里云 Agent Sandbox 作为可独立配置、默认关闭的插件组件打包，使用官方 DSH 工具与生命周期接口。[配置方式、持久化前提与验证范围](docs/sandbox-plugins.zh.md)。

云端项目：[配置、生命周期与验证范围](docs/cloud-projects.zh.md)。




首次引导的办公选项和跳过操作保留完整智能体预设列表；紧凑聊天只改变轨迹与用量展示，不再关闭编程视图。既有配置可在设置中开启“编程视图”恢复 PTC 和极简模式。

官方视觉模型通道在请求时读取 DSH 的持久附件服务，支持用户图片及工具返回的截图。沿用原生附件和文件系统映射，不建立另一套图片存储。

源码和桌面配置允许 Studio 使用的固定版本 esbuild、sharp 构建，跳过 ONNX 安装后的额外下载：Studio 使用包内已有的 CPU 后端。保留管理员已有构建策略。首次安装仍需获取 npm 依赖，后续安装复用包管理器缓存。

组织模型支持 `shared`（默认共用）和 `member`（成员独立）两种凭证模式。成员模式下，获授权成员从“我的 API Key”保存自己的凭证；账号服务加密保存，列表接口不返回原文，执行时必须属于该组织项目。更换接口地址或凭证模式会清理成员 Key；移除成员或服务会清理对应 Key。退出登录只断开本机账号，保留服务端成员 Key，不修改其他设备。

## 精选市场管理

现有市场仅在 `/api/v1/market/manage` 确认登录账号拥有平台 `admin` 角色后显示“添加插件”。企业所有者或企业管理员不因此获得公共市场发布权限；每次写入由账号服务再次校验。表单只需粘贴公开 GitHub 仓库地址、npm 包名或 npm 包页面。未经修改的 DSH 官方参考生成器自动读取名称、多语言介绍、图标、发布版本和兼容范围；仓库有多个插件时先选择一个，预览固定的兼容版本后确认添加。高级设置提供可选的展示文案、分类和 npm 安装注册表覆盖，不复制、安装、执行或审核第三方代码。重复包名会被拒绝，已有内置条目优先保留。

新增引用集中保存在账号服务现有的加密 settings 中，写入串行化并在同一事务保存审计记录，无需新增数据库表。`/api/market/catalog` 仅公开有数量和大小限制的推荐引用，套件将其与内置目录合并。服务不可用或尚未升级时，内置插件仍可浏览，添加入口隐藏。管理功能需要同时部署两个包，本地构建不会部署。

公开来源识别通过构建时打包的固定版本官方生成器运行，使用有时限的子进程，不是第二套 Agent runtime。可在高级设置填写自定义 HTTPS npm 安装注册表。大陆与海外自动选源、安装包镜像属于后续部署步骤：仅同步已审核版本和允许分发的文件，校验内容哈希，再路由至等价来源。此表单没有启用公共代理、自动镜像或地域检测。现有用户页面和安装对话框保持不变。

# Operation recorder

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Independent DSH bundle `@ipollo/dsh-operation-recorder`, migrated from the multi-engine iPolloWork recorder 0.3.0. Retains semantic desktop capture, pause/resume, saved recordings, Chrome Recorder import, redaction, editable steps, deterministic Skill compilation and export. No model keys or second Agent runtime.

## Build and install

Run `npm ci --legacy-peer-deps`, `npm run link:workspace` for monorepo development, `npm run check`, `npm run pack:check`, then `npm pack`. Build the root official runtime first. Full native builds require Go 1.26; macOS universal capture also requires Swift 6/Xcode command-line tools. The package includes prebuilt capture helpers; end users need no compiler. Install the resulting `.tgz` using `dsh plugin --profile <profile> add /absolute/path/ipollo-dsh-operation-recorder-0.2.0.tgz`. Check the target profile before installation.

Open **操作录制**, select an existing DSH workspace and open the workbench. Recording requires explicit system permissions. Windows uses UI Automation and passive hooks, Linux X11 uses XRecord/AT-SPI, macOS uses Accessibility/CGEventTap. Wayland supports Chrome Recorder import, not full desktop capture. Previous live capture limitations remain; cross-compilation and mock tests do not prove real desktop input capture on each platform.

The `ipollo_recorder` tool exposes `status`, `review`, `import-chrome`, `compile` with arguments in `input`; writes reject read-only sessions. Capture and permission requests stay in the user workbench. **AI refinement** opens a native DSH conversation with an unsent draft, preserving existing text; the user reviews and sends it. Generated `.tgz` files are real independent DSH Skill bundles, with `package.json`, `cordis.patch.yml`, lifecycle registration, `SKILL.md` and `references/workflow.json`. They can be installed using the same official plugin command. A draft export does not mean successful replay or human approval.

Records are stored under `<workspace>/.ipollowork/plugins/operation-recorder/workspaces/<workspace-hash>`. Old recorder data is not moved or deleted automatically; Chrome JSON remains importable. Disabling releases HTTP listeners and native capture processes; uninstalling preserves records. Workbench routes require a DSH owner connection and service credentials remain on the Host. This is not isolation from arbitrary shell access or other Host plugins.

`npm run check` covers input redaction, imports, versioned exports, workspace isolation, symlink rejection, native helper mocks and service disposal. Real DSH/client and real platform capture checks are additional. See `LICENSE`, `NOTICE.txt`, and `native/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt`.

## 0.2 evidence and refinement

An optional workflow goal, quality findings (missing target, missing completion condition, empty/active recording), compact `prepare` evidence and paginated `events` now guide refinement. AI compile calls require the current `expectedRevision` and cannot grant human approval. Exports persist as the latest preview and reappear after reopening; changed evidence invalidates them. Bundles include `references/evidence.json` and `evals/evals.json`, explicitly marked `not_run`, without inventing missing assertions. Evidence remains plugin-owned workspace files, with no database or new service.

Research references: [humblebanana/dsh-record-replay](https://github.com/humblebanana/dsh-record-replay/tree/32d06f7db906914e278d1552728d1d63f191d6ad) separates evidence validation, preparation and skill creation; [kangshifu1/dsh-record-replay](https://github.com/kangshifu1/dsh-record-replay/tree/e1015e57a4f815dba5f4776f6ae9d969a3e25ddf) uses video frames for visual skill generation. Sources were inspected; neither runtime was copied or installed in the user's profile. This release strengthens the existing semantic workflow; screen video, autonomous replay and community-plugin compatibility on rc.3 are not claimed. The macOS collector also records printable-key intent in custom editors with incomplete accessibility roles, without reading typed characters; unnamed targets still require evidence or user clarification.

[English](README.md) | 中文

`ipollo_recorder` 提供 `status`、`review`、`import-chrome`、`compile`，参数放在 `input`；只读会话拒绝写入。采集和权限申请由用户工作台发起。“AI 提炼”打开原生 DSH 会话并填入未发送草稿，保留已有文字，由用户检查后发送。生成的 `.tgz` 是独立 DSH Skill 插件，包含 `package.json`、`cordis.patch.yml`、生命周期注册、`SKILL.md`、`references/workflow.json`，可使用同一个官方安装命令。导出草稿不代表重放成功或人工审核通过。
