GitHub job evidence selects the original runner; its local manifest supplies the preset, version, source and channel before approval. No installer or request artifact is downloaded. Retained packages with the old `publishRequested=false` flag remain eligible; missing or changed local files stop publication. Before installing dependencies on the original runner, preparation and the approved publish job check that the selected `publishing/.json` is readable JSON. Missing configuration reports its path; restore it and retry publication with the same package. Full configuration and signature validation still run afterward. Before uploading, the publisher hashes all retained files, checks version and destination metadata, and rechecks the platform signatures. macOS verifies the DMG and extracts the ZIP to verify the app's ticket; Windows checks Authenticode, the configured signer thumbprint and the timestamp. Preparation writes a Chinese approval summary with separate version, channel, platform and deployment fields, the retained test release ID, full installer/feed URLs, a link to the original packaging attempt, source ref/SHA, platform verification results and proposed tag. Folded details include the COS bucket and file sizes/SHA-256 of the upload bytes, including rewritten YAML. Public-repository summaries expose the test prefix and download URLs; the prefix is not authentication. Both publishing jobs wait for **Review deployments → Approve and deploy**, then recheck the approved manifest and upload plan digest. Changed bytes or destinations reject. Approval cannot edit a version; reject and rebuild instead. Both deployments upload missing binaries, verify remote bytes, then update YAML. There is no files-only mode in this workflow. Production finally creates `desktop-v` at the recorded packaging commit; an existing tag must name the same commit. ## Rollout and website publication For a 10% → 30% → 100% rollout, first publish through COS with `staging_percentage=10` and `upload_website=false`. Then dispatch **Publish Desktop · Rollout & Website** from `main` with the original package run ID and selected attempt (defaults to 1; verify it against the package run). Set `rollout_percentage` to 30, then 100 for progressive delivery; leave it empty for website-only publication. `upload_website` defaults to false; select a percentage or enable website publication. For this sequence, enable it on the final invocation to upload the production website installer and refresh its cache. Website publication is independent of the rollout percentage and does not require 100%; the installer is available to all website download users. Percentage changes require approval before modifying the feed. Website upload requires a separate approval; after a successful upload, cache refresh runs without another approval. A failed or cancelled upload prevents refresh. Website-only mode skips the percentage-change job and requires only website approval; the upload job still verifies the current feed without changing its percentage. Each platform uses its own package run. Preparation checks GitHub identity, the retained manifest, the small update YAML and a completed initial publication record; it does not rehash package binaries or repeat signature/notarization checks. After Environment approval, execution reads the current COS feed, verifies that its version, payload URL, size, hash and other metadata still match the published package, and changes only `stagingPercentage`. Missing or replaced feeds reject the operation. Repeating the same percentage is a no-op; lowering the percentage is rejected. The approval shows the requested percentage; the current percentage is read from COS during execution. Website upload reuses the original retained installer, hashes that installer alone and uses the existing upload/purge recovery records. Rollout cache-only retries validate the prepared website approval digest and upload journal. They require neither another Environment approval nor the retained update YAML or initial feed journal. The website upload holds the feed channel lock through installer verification and upload so a newer feed cannot replace the selected version midway; competing publications on that channel fail while the lock is held. A metadata-only rollout therefore does not require installer files, but website publication requires its installer. Percentage changes retain before/after YAML in separate rollout audit records. Initial COS publication remains required; this workflow never builds packages, uploads versioned binaries or creates release tags. ## Recovery and records The archival job creates the Windows installer ZIP or macOS metadata ZIP in store mode with system bsdtar: `%SystemRoot%\System32\tar.exe` on Windows, or `/usr/bin/tar` on macOS. `invalid ZIP output settings` rejects a missing or malformed archive name and missing retained-directory, temporary-directory or `GITHUB_OUTPUT` settings before file verification. `desktop archival: SystemRoot is required to locate Windows bsdtar` reports a missing Windows system directory setting. `ZIP creation failed with ` identifies the failed archive tool; inspect its stderr, tool availability and free space in `RUNNER_TEMP`. `split macOS artifacts require one DMG and one update ZIP` rejects Windows input or an incomplete macOS inventory; select the original complete macOS build, and omit `--split-macos` for Windows. `desktop archival: usage` rejects unsupported arguments; use no arguments for Windows or only `--split-macos` for macOS. The packaging workflows separate `package` from `upload-artifact` (GitHub artifact archival). All packaging modes, including test and unsigned builds, require `DESKTOP_PUBLISH_RUNNERS` before packaging; it routes archival to the original machine. Rerun only `upload-artifact` after an archival failure; it verifies the original manifest and hashes without rebuilding, signing or notarizing. Packaging diagnostics are best effort and do not change package success. If an archival retry stays queued without a runner, inspect the resolved runner label and upstream package outputs before treating the runner as offline. Missing outputs require operator recovery of the original retained directory and manifest; rerunning the whole workflow rebuilds the package and is not archival-only recovery. Verify output reuse in the Actions acceptance test. Production COS publication enables website installer upload and cache refresh by default (`upload_website=true`). Clear it to publish only versioned resources and automatic-update feeds; test publication never changes the production website. `upload-website-installer` uploads the fixed installer and `purge-website-installer` refreshes its URL. The website installer validator needs only the final DMG/EXE and retained manifest. It matches production qualification, build identity and target, hashes the installer once and uploads through the same open file handle. Both production nightly and stable packages can replace the fixed website installer. Operators select the intended version; the fixed object has no downgrade protection, so rerunning an older publication can replace a newer installer. The pre-approval summary names the fixed website URL, selected version and lack of downgrade protection when website upload is selected. The existing version/update publication retains its own checks. Set `edgeOneZoneId` in each publishing runner’s `publishing/production.json` to the production EdgeOne zone (for example, `"edgeOneZoneId": "zone-example"`). Website publication requires this field before approval; COS-only publication and rollout do not. Actions do not read the repository variable `DOWNLOAD_PROD_EO_ZONE_ID`. The production COS credential pair also needs `teo:CreatePurgeTask` and `teo:DescribePurgeTasks`. Website uploads serialize by bucket/target in Actions and by bucket/object on the original machine. Cache observation runs separately. In the COS workflow, version publication, website upload and cache refresh each use the production approval Environment. In the Rollout workflow, only percentage changes and website upload use it; cache refresh follows the approved upload without another Environment approval. Rerunning a job with an Environment may require approval again. GitHub concurrency retains at most one pending job per group, so a newer pending job can cancel an older pending job; inspect canceled jobs before rerunning them. Website state lives in `upload-records/website--/state.json`, beside the retained releases root. macOS and Windows use the same record format on separate local disks. Website URLs and download filenames follow the [fixed-download rules](../README.md#fixed-downloads). Upload retries reconcile both bytes and `Content-Disposition`; identical bytes with a missing or different header receive one upload and readback. A completed journal with different remote bytes stops recovery and requires a newly approved publication. Completion evidence survives failed metadata repairs. Each new upload intent clears the previous purge record, so repaired metadata requires a new cache refresh; inspect EdgeOne history for the previous task ID and diagnostics. Unknown writes are read before any retry; CDN header forwarding requires real-environment validation. Rerun only the purge job to inspect its saved task when the original routing and preparation outputs remain available. With website upload enabled, website jobs skip only an explicitly selected test deployment. Each job requires its injected `route` or `selection` output for local preflight. Missing or changed website approval fails before upload or purge submission. Missing `website-destination` broadens both website concurrency groups. Missing `runner` output can prevent scheduling before preflight. Stop partial retries when outputs are missing; the workflow does not reconstruct them. Before restarting the publication workflow, inspect current remote state and obtain approval for its upload scope; this is not cache-only recovery. Do not rerun packaging to recover publication outputs. A manually rerun purge may submit once after confirming the previous task failed. A lost submission response queries matching history instead of resubmitting. An unknown result with a task ID means submission was confirmed; without an ID it may never have been submitted. Inspect EdgeOne history before manual recovery, and a fresh publication run is one recovery option. Operators may instead use the documented [fixed-download purge command](../README.md#fixed-downloads); Windows operators use the existing DPAPI credential launcher described there. This submits only a fixed-URL purge: it does not observe completion or update this Actions run’s journal. Inspect the returned task in EdgeOne before considering recovery complete. Purge observation waits up to five minutes at ten-second intervals, with one additional query after an unknown result or observation deadline. Confirmed failed, timeout or canceled tasks fail the job. An unresolved result exits successfully with an Actions warning and a prominent summary; its durable state remains unknown, not completed. Diagnostic artifact archival is best effort; local records remain the recovery source. Simulated-provider tests cover these paths; release operators must verify production COS/EdgeOne permissions, job-id filtering, time-range queries, task type and timestamp formats, cross-attempt Actions recovery, and actual CDN behavior before relying on recovery in production. After resolving a failure, re-run the failed publishing job only when the upstream outputs required above remain available, keeping its prepared package attempt; otherwise stop partial retries. A new publication can explicitly select the original package run and attempt. Re-running all jobs with a blank attempt resolves the latest package attempt again and requires a new approval. Do not rebuild solely to retry an upload. Missing objects are uploaded, identical objects are skipped, and conflicting same-name bytes stop the operation. Unknown write outcomes are reconciled by reading remote bytes. A newer channel version prevents a stale upload from replacing it. Each package updates only its embedded channel: nightly writes `nightly.yml` / `nightly-mac.yml`, stable writes `stable.yml` / `stable-mac.yml`. Stable-channel binaries use a `stable/` subdirectory under the target binary prefix, separate from existing nightly objects. Publishing the same source/version to both channels requires two packages; an existing release tag is reused only for the same source commit. The sibling `upload-records/` directory retains an operation identity, newline-delimited events and terminal result. Feed-write intents retain both previous and requested YAML. Failures record their stage, safe error classification and diagnostic; COS failures also identify `GetObject` or `PutObject`, plus a validated HTTP status and request ID when available. Access-denied reports name the permission to inspect. Raw provider responses and credentials are excluded. Audit initialization becomes visible only after its files are complete; abandoned `.initializing-*` directories are not scanned for completed publication. Writes and readback are recorded before proceeding; missing terminal results mean interruption, not success. Actions also keeps its operation record as a diagnostic artifact for 30 days. These local records are not tamper-proof. COS readback verifies storage bytes, not public CDN behavior; public download acceptance is separate. If the feed completed but tagging failed, the result is `published-tag-pending` and the job fails visibly. On retry, durable feed-completion evidence permits only tag recovery, even if a later release has advanced the channel. It never re-publishes old YAML. An existing conflicting tag requires administrator investigation and is never moved automatically. A rejected tag creation retains its HTTP status and validated GitHub request ID; a follow-up lookup does not replace that failure with a missing-tag error. A repository-rule rejection directs the operator to the matching rulesets without logging the raw response. Normal publication and manual restoration acquire the same local channel lock. A crash can leave a lock directory under the sibling `publish-locks/`; verify no writer is running before manually removing it. A runner label alone does not coordinate writers on other machines. Keep one publishing machine per channel and preserve its records when migrating. ## Restore a channel Run the repository script `apps/desktop/scripts/rollback-desktop-channel.ts` through `node --import tsx` on the publishing machine. Keep `GITHUB_REPOSITORY`, `RUNNER_NAME`, `DSH_PACKAGING_CONFIG_DIR` and `DESKTOP_PUBLISH_ROUTE` set to the original package context. The route JSON contains `runId`, `attempt`, `commit`, `runnerName`, `target`, `preset`, `sourceRef` and `channel`, available in the retained manifest's source fields. Pass `--record` with that successful publication's audit directory, `--expected-version` with the version currently online, and `--reason` with the operational reason. Without `--execute`, the script reads remote objects and prints the exact YAML change without writing. Preview requires COS read credentials. With `--execute`, it verifies historical files, preserves before/after YAML in a new audit record, checks the current channel again, and restores only YAML. It neither uploads binaries nor changes tags. A channel already matching the target bytes is skipped; other channels must match the expected current version. This permits recovery after one feed was restored before an interruption. A different current version aborts the operation. Restoration is not a multi-object transaction; inspect the audit after any partial failure before continuing. The Desktop client disables automatic downgrade. Restoring an old feed can stop additional clients receiving a bad release; clients already on a newer version do not downgrade. A higher-version corrective release is a separate recovery path. ## Dev Note None.

--- description: "在专用 macOS 和 Windows runner 上发布留存的 Desktop 安装包。" --- # Desktop CI 发布 [English](README.md) | 中文 ## 概述 在原打包机器上发布完整安装包，无需再次下载安装包。test 和 production 都先发布二进制文件，再更新 YAML。两种环境都需要 GitHub Environment 审批；只有 production 通过 GitHub App 创建 tag。真实 COS、CDN 和管理员权限仍需部署验收；本地 fixture 不证明这些权限可用。 ## 目录 - [配置顺序](#setup-sequence) - [Runner 标签与排队排查](#runner-labels) - [机器配置](#machine-setup) - [打包与发布](#package-and-publish) - [放量与官网发布](#rollout-and-website-publication) - [恢复与记录](#recovery-and-records) - [恢复频道](#restore-a-channel) ## 配置顺序 首次配置专用机器时按此顺序操作。部署操作员负责注册、凭据、审批和真实上传验收；仓库检查不能证明机器已具备发布能力。 1. 准备 runner 专用 checkout 和仓库外的配置目录。按 [Windows 机器与签名配置](../../windows-signing/README.zh.md#machine-setup)或 [macOS runner 与签名配置](../../packaging/README.zh.md#macos-actions)准备工具、模板和平台凭据。 2. 通过 GitHub **Settings → Actions → Runners** 或组织的 runner 管理页面注册 runner。记录准确的注册名称，允许本仓库访问其 runner group，并分配[必需标签](#runner-labels)。注册时保留默认标签。 3. 按平台指南安装并启动守护任务。Windows 计划任务和 macOS LaunchAgent 都要求配置的用户登录，不能在登录前无人值守启动。确认已连接 GitHub 且出现 `Listening for Jobs`，再检查 GitHub 中 runner 在线。 4. 完成[本机发布配置](#machine-setup)、仓库变量 `DESKTOP_PUBLISH_RUNNERS` 和两个部署 Environment。仓库管理员负责路由与审批人；COS 管理员负责桶配置及对象读写权限；production 还需要配置 GitHub App。 5. 按[打包与发布](#package-and-publish)完成一次 Windows 已签名或 macOS 已公证的 **test** 打包。确认打包 job 使用预期的注册 runner 并留存文件。从 `main` 发起发布，填写该 run ID 和 attempt；确认 `prepare` 确实在同一台机器上启动并生成审批摘要。 6. 审核摘要中的环境、版本、频道和 URL 后，再批准测试上传。验证发布记录、公开安装包下载和升级 feed。test 验收不能证明 production 权限可用：production 需独立配置与审批。保留 run/attempt 和验收结果，供故障恢复使用。 ## Runner 标签与排队排查 GitHub 要求 runner 同时匹配 job 的 `runs-on` 列表中的全部标签。[默认标签规则](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/how-tos/manage-runners/self-hosted-runners/use-in-a-workflow)说明了为什么使用 `--no-default-labels` 注册后，runner 即使在线也可能无法接单。当前工作流要求： | Job | 同一台 runner 必须具备的标签 | | --- | --- | | Windows 打包 | `dsh-win-package-trial` | | macOS 打包 | `self-hosted`、`macOS`、`ARM64`、`dsh-mac-package-trial` | | 所有原机发布和放量任务 | `self-hosted`，以及选中的 `DESKTOP_PUBLISH_RUNNERS` 条目中的 `label` | 只有 `dsh-win-package-trial` 的 runner 可以打包 Windows，却不能接发布任务。路由条目不会给 GitHub 中注册的 runner 添加标签。需由 runner 管理员修正注册标签；修改路由的 `target` 或重启正常监听的进程都不能补齐缺失标签。 job 排队时，先对照 job 页面请求的标签与 **Settings → Actions → Runners** 中的标签，再检查仓库/group 访问权限，以及匹配的 runner 是否在线且空闲。守护任务运行只说明进程存在。托管的 `route` job 成功只说明已选定打包任务，不代表 `prepare` 能被分配。部署等待审批时需要 Environment 审批人操作，已经分配但失败的 job 则需查看步骤日志。重启前先区分这些状态。 ## 机器配置 保持 `DSH_PACKAGING_CONFIG_DIR` 指向现有机器打包目录。完成的构建复制到其同级 `releases///`；`DSH_DESKTOP_RELEASES_DIR` 可用绝对路径覆盖该根目录。文件清单包含安装包、更新归档、blockmap、完成记录和不含凭据的 manifest。调试包会留存，但不能发布。复制内容通过校验后才开放 attempt 目录，已有 attempt 不能被替换。GitHub 保留相同文件清单 14 天。本地文件保留到操作员删除；校验或发布期间不要删除对应 attempt。 从 [macOS test](../../config/publishing/macos/test.json.example)、[macOS production](../../config/publishing/macos/production.json.example)、[Windows test](../../config/publishing/windows/test.json.example) 或 [Windows production](../../config/publishing/windows/production.json.example) 模板开始，创建 `publishing/` 目录，将所选文件复制到 `DSH_PACKAGING_CONFIG_DIR` 下的 `publishing/.json`。用机器实际配置替换示例 bucket、test origin、绝对路径、macOS 签名身份和 Team ID 或 Windows 证书指纹，以及 production App client ID；保留固定的 production origin。模板不含凭据，也不授予 COS、GitHub 或签名权限。引用的秘密文件保存在 Git 之外，只允许发布账户访问。macOS 的 arm64 和 x64 共用配置，目标由留存包决定。 每份配置声明 `bucket`、不带路径的 HTTPS `origin` 和绝对路径 `credentialsFile`。凭据文件只包含 `secretId` 和 `secretKey`。macOS 还需 `macOS.signingIdentity` 和 `macOS.teamId`；Windows 需要 `windows.certificateThumbprint`。production 必须使用 origin `https://download.deepseek.com`，并提供 `githubApp.clientId` 和绝对路径 `githubApp.privateKeyFile`。上传器支持长期 COS 凭据，不支持 STS 会话凭据。管理员必须维持 test 和 production bucket 未启用版本控制（不能是已启用或已暂停状态）。发布流程以此为部署前提，不调用 `GetBucketVersioning`，也不要求该权限。二进制 PUT 仍携带 `x-cos-forbid-overwrite`；防覆盖保证依赖管理员维持桶配置。 将仓库变量 `DESKTOP_PUBLISH_RUNNERS` 配置为已注册 runner 名称到唯一标签和目标的 JSON 映射，例如 `{"mini":{"label":"dsh-mini-publish","target":["mac-arm64","mac-x64"]}}`。该标签只能分配给这台 runner。目标可为单个名称或非空列表；上述 Mac 条目允许同一台机器处理两种架构的打包工作流。Windows 使用目标 `win-x64`。留存包的目标必须与所选打包工作流一致。路由 job 检查原构建成功的 job，发布器再检查自身 runner 名称与记录一致。机器之间不需要共享文件系统或局域网连接。 管理员必须创建 `desktop-test` 和 `desktop-production`，分别设置必需审批人并允许 `main` 部署分支。工作流会检查两种环境的审批人配置。test 可允许发起者自行审批。GitHub App 需要安装到本仓库、具有 Contents write 权限，并获准在 `desktop-v*` tag ruleset 下创建发布 tag。审批不会把审批人的 tag 权限传给 App。缺少配置会停止发布，不回退到个人 token。App action 创建短期 token，并在结束后撤销。使用发布账户的文件系统权限保护本机私钥及 COS 凭据文件。token action 需要密钥内容，因此已屏蔽日志的 PEM 在 job 期间也会经过 runner 临时 `GITHUB_OUTPUT` 文件；日志屏蔽不限制本地文件访问。 Environment 审批限制此工作流，不限制同一机器账户运行的任意代码。账户隔离和强制源分支限制属于独立运维工作。保持现有发布 Environment 不变。test job 使用自己的审批人，不创建真实发布 tag；本地模拟接口覆盖 tag 创建与恢复，但不验证 App 权限。 ## 打包与发布 发布表单支持可选的 `staging_percentage`，取值为 0 到 100 的整数。该值作用于保留包所属的 nightly 或 stable 渠道，显示在审批摘要中，并写入发布的 YAML 和审计记录，不修改保留产物。留空沿用包内默认值（通常为全量）。已完成的发布不能通过重试修改比例；同版本清单内容冲突仍会报错。 发布到 test 或 production 都必须在 Windows 选择 `signing=signed`，或在 macOS 不勾选**跳过公证**。无签名、无公证的包仅限内部调试，不能发布或用于自动更新。托管路由 job 会在安装依赖前，依据所选 run 和 attempt 对应的 artifact 名称拒绝已标明的调试包。仅重跑归档时，artifact 名称保留原构建 attempt，早期检查可能未识别该包；本地清单资格校验仍会在发布前拒绝调试包。缺少 artifact 元数据不代表允许发布：原机器仍会验证留存清单和签名。遇到调试包拒绝提示时，需重新完成签名或公证，再使用新包的 run ID / attempt 发布；重跑发布不能使现有产物获得发布资格。 选择对应平台的 `Package Desktop` 工作流、preset、源码、通道和版本模式。test 的 `source_ref` 接受仓库内分支名（如 `feature/desktop-update`）或 `dsh-v*` tag；production 仅接受 `main` 或 `dsh-v*` tag。符合 `dsh-v` 后接数字、其余为字母、数字、点或连字符的名称按 tag 处理，即使存在同名分支。tag 必须与所选产品版本一致。建议从 `main` 启动打包工作流，再单独填写打包源码；不支持直接填写 commit SHA、PR ref 或 fork 仓库。源码必须包含 CI 适配脚本，旧源码会在安装依赖前失败。仅选择可信分支：其构建代码将在签名机器上执行。这是操作约定，不提供工作流来源强制限制或凭据隔离。发布使用记录的 commit，并要求该提交仍在所选分支历史中；正常追加提交不影响发布，删除分支或导致历史分叉的强推会拒绝。tag 发布要求 tag 仍指向记录的提交。从 `main` 发起发布；托管路由 job 会在派发到原机器前拒绝其他 ref。实际打包源码提交单独记录。`version_mode=default` 对 production 选择 follow-dsh，对 test 选择 build-number；follow-dsh 跟随所选源码的 dsh 包版本号，build-number 在任一环境均追加日期/run/attempt，manual 要求填写 `build_version`。已有派发命令中的 `-f version_mode=auto` 须改为 `-f version_mode=build-number`，`-f version_mode=product` 改为 `-f version_mode=follow-dsh`；本地 CLI 的 `--build-version auto` 不变。工作流暂时传递旧模式名，以兼容已含 CI 适配脚本但早于模式改名的源码；当前解析器同时接受新旧名称。计划于 2027-01-04 同时删除 workflow 映射和解析器别名，并要求所选源码支持新模式名；该日期不会触发自动失效。操作人员选择的渠道接受任意受支持的构建版本，包括 alpha 和 RC 版本；渠道不改变版本优先级，也不允许客户端降级。可选 `test_release_id` 是测试 URL 前缀：留空沿用机器默认值，同一平台连续升级测试需保持相同值，并应定期轮换默认值。它不是 GitHub run ID。格式校验和轮换限制见[打包配置](../../packaging/README.zh.md#configuration-and-local-builds)。 打包只保留文件。成功后，在 `main` 上打开 **Publish Desktop · COS → Run workflow**，填写打包运行 URL 中的 `package_run_id`，并可填写 `package_run_attempt`。留空选择最新尝试及其成功的 package job；归档重跑继续使用原始构建 attempt，新的构建失败时不回退到较早成功构建。显式填写则选择对应构建，独立的 GitHub 归档失败不取消其资格。Windows 必须完成签名，macOS 必须完成公证和 stapling。GitHub job 证据确定原 runner，本机清单在审批前提供 preset、版本、源码和通道。不会下载安装包或请求 artifact。旧清单的 `publishRequested=false` 不影响发布资格；本机文件缺失或变化会停止发布。 在原 runner 安装依赖前，准备阶段和审批后的发布 job 都会检查所选 `publishing/.json` 是否为可读取的 JSON。配置缺失时会报告路径；补齐后可使用同一个包重试发布。之后仍会执行完整配置与签名校验。上传前，发布器校验全部留存文件的哈希、版本及目标信息，再复核平台签名。macOS 校验 DMG，并解压 ZIP 校验 app 票据；Windows 校验 Authenticode、配置的签名证书指纹及时间戳。准备阶段生成中文审批摘要，分别展示版本、通道、平台和环境，以及留存的 test release ID、安装包与升级 YAML 的完整 URL、原打包尝试链接、源码 ref/SHA、平台校验结果及拟创建的 tag。折叠详情包含 COS 存储桶，以及实际上传字节的大小和 SHA-256（包括改写后的 YAML）。公开仓库的摘要会公开测试前缀和下载 URL；前缀不提供访问鉴权。两种发布 job 均等待 **Review deployments → Approve and deploy**，随后重新核对已批准的 manifest 与上传计划摘要。文件或目标变化会被拒绝。审批不能修改版本；应拒绝并重新打包。两种环境都上传缺失文件、校验远端字节，再更新 YAML。此工作流没有只上传文件的模式。production 最后为记录的打包提交创建 `desktop-v`；已有 tag 必须指向同一提交。 ## 放量与官网发布 按 10% → 30% → 100% 放量时，先通过 COS 流程以 `staging_percentage=10`、`upload_website=false` 完成首次发布，再从 `main` 发起 **Publish Desktop · Rollout & Website**，填写原打包 run ID 并选择 attempt（默认 1，请与原打包 run 核对）。逐步放量时将 `rollout_percentage` 分别设为 30、100；仅发布官网时留空。`upload_website` 默认为 false；必须填写比例或启用官网发布。在此示例中，最后一轮启用它即可上传生产官网安装器并刷新缓存。官网发布独立于放量比例，不要求达到 100%；官网安装包面向所有下载用户。修改放量比例前审批一次，官网上传前另行审批一次；上传成功后自动刷新缓存，不再重复审批。上传失败或取消时不执行刷新。仅发布官网时跳过放量 job，只需官网审批；上传 job 仍校验当前 feed，不修改放量比例。每个平台使用各自的打包 run。 准备阶段检查 GitHub 身份、保留清单、小体积更新 YAML 和已完成的首次发布记录，不重新计算安装包哈希，也不重复检查签名或公证。Environment 审批后，执行阶段读取当前 COS 更新清单，核对版本、安装包 URL、大小、哈希和其他元数据仍对应已发布包，只修改 `stagingPercentage`。更新清单缺失或已被其他包替换时拒绝执行。同一比例重复执行不写入；不允许降低比例。审批展示目标比例，当前比例在执行时从 COS 读取。 官网上传复用原机保留的安装器，只校验该安装器的哈希，沿用已有上传与刷新恢复记录。Rollout 仅重试缓存刷新时校验准备阶段生成的官网审批摘要和上传记录，不再要求 Environment 审批，不再依赖原更新 YAML 或首次 feed 发布记录。官网上传在安装器校验、上传期间保持频道锁，防止中途被更新的 feed 替换；此时竞争该频道的发布会失败。因此纯放量不需要安装器文件，发布官网则需要。比例变更前后的 YAML 写入独立放量审计记录。此流程必须在首次 COS 发布之后执行，不构建安装包、不上传版本化安装包，也不创建 release tag。 ## 恢复与记录 归档 job 使用系统 bsdtar 创建 store 模式的 Windows 安装包 ZIP 或 macOS 元数据 ZIP：Windows 为 `%SystemRoot%\System32\tar.exe`，macOS 为 `/usr/bin/tar`。`invalid ZIP output settings` 表示归档名称缺失或格式非法，或保留目录、临时目录、`GITHUB_OUTPUT` 缺失，会在校验文件前拒绝。`desktop archival: SystemRoot is required to locate Windows bsdtar` 表示缺失 Windows 系统目录设置。`ZIP creation failed with ` 指明失败的归档工具；检查其 stderr、工具是否可用，以及 `RUNNER_TEMP` 剩余空间。`split macOS artifacts require one DMG and one update ZIP` 拒绝 Windows 输入或不完整的 macOS 清单；选择原始完整 macOS 构建，Windows 不传 `--split-macos`。`desktop archival: usage` 拒绝不支持的参数；Windows 不传参数，macOS 仅传 `--split-macos`。 打包 workflow 将 `package` 与 `upload-artifact`（GitHub 产物归档）分开。所有打包模式（包括 test 和 unsigned）都要求在打包前配置 `DESKTOP_PUBLISH_RUNNERS`，用于将归档路由到原机器。归档失败后仅重跑 `upload-artifact`；它校验原始 manifest 和 hash，不重新构建、签名或公证。打包诊断归档尽力执行，不改变构建成功状态。归档重跑若一直排队且未分配 runner，应先检查解析出的 runner 标签和上游 package 输出，不能直接认定机器离线。输出缺失时需由操作者从原留存目录和 manifest 恢复文件；重跑整个 workflow 会重新构建，不属于仅归档恢复。Actions 验收须验证输出复用。 生产 COS 发布默认启用官网安装包上传和缓存刷新（`upload_website=true`）。取消后仅发布版本化资源及自动更新清单；test 发布不修改生产官网。`upload-website-installer` 上传固定安装包，`purge-website-installer` 刷新该 URL。官网安装包校验器只需要最终 DMG/EXE 和保留的 manifest，匹配生产资格、构建身份及平台，只计算一次安装包 hash，并通过同一打开的文件句柄上传。production nightly 和 stable 包都可以替换官网固定安装包。操作者负责选择预期版本；固定对象没有防降级保护，重跑旧发布可能覆盖新安装包。勾选官网上传时，审批前摘要展示固定官网 URL、选定版本和无防降级保护的说明。原有版本与自动更新发布保留自身校验。 在每台发布 runner 的 `publishing/production.json` 中将 `edgeOneZoneId` 配置为生产 EdgeOne 站点（例如 `"edgeOneZoneId": "zone-example"`）。官网发布在审批前要求该字段；仅 COS 发布和放量不需要。Actions 不读取仓库变量 `DOWNLOAD_PROD_EO_ZONE_ID`。生产 COS 凭据还需要 `teo:CreatePurgeTask` 和 `teo:DescribePurgeTasks` 权限。官网上传在 Actions 中按 bucket/平台互斥，在原机器上按 bucket/对象互斥；缓存观察单独运行。COS 工作流的版本发布、官网上传和缓存刷新分别使用生产审批 Environment。Rollout 工作流仅在放量修改和官网上传时使用它；缓存刷新跟随已批准的上传执行，不再要求 Environment 审批。重跑带 Environment 的 job 可能需要再次审批。GitHub 每个并发组最多保留一个排队 job，新排队 job 可能取消旧排队 job；重跑前应检查取消记录。 官网状态保存在 releases 根目录同级的 `upload-records/website-<发布 run ID>-/state.json`。macOS 和 Windows 在各自本地磁盘使用相同记录格式。官网 URL 和保存文件名遵循[固定下载规则](../README.zh.md#fixed-downloads)。上传重跑同时核对字节和 `Content-Disposition`；字节相同但响应头缺失或错误时，上传一次并读回验证。记录已完成但远端字节改变时停止恢复，需要重新审批发布。完成标记在元数据修复失败后仍保留。每次新的上传意图清除旧刷新记录，因此修复元数据后需重新刷新缓存；上一次任务 ID 和诊断需查 EdgeOne 历史。未知写入先读取再决定重试；CDN 响应头透传仍需实测。原机器路由和准备阶段输出完整时，仅重跑刷新 job 即可查询已保存任务。启用官网上传时，官网 job 仅跳过明确选择的 test 环境。各 job 的本地预检要求其注入的 `route` 或 `selection` 输出存在。官网审批缺失或变化时，在上传或提交刷新任务前失败。`website-destination` 缺失会扩大两个官网并发组的互斥范围。`runner` 输出缺失可能导致无法调度，尚未进入预检。输出缺失时停止局部重试，workflow 不重建这些输出。重新启动发布 workflow 前，先检查当前远端状态并确认上传范围的审批；这不属于仅缓存恢复。不要为恢复发布输出重跑打包。人工重跑确认旧任务失败后可提交一次。提交响应丢失时查询匹配的历史记录，不重新提交。unknown 带任务 ID 表示提交已确认；没有 ID 则可能从未提交。人工恢复前应检查 EdgeOne 历史，重新发起发布运行是恢复方式之一。操作者也可使用已有的[固定下载刷新命令](../README.zh.md#fixed-downloads)；Windows 操作者使用该处说明的 DPAPI 凭据启动器。该命令只提交固定 URL 刷新，不观察完成状态，也不更新本次 Actions 运行的 journal。确认恢复完成前应在 EdgeOne 检查返回的任务。 刷新观察每十秒查询一次，最长五分钟；结果未知或观察超时后额外查询一次。明确的 failed、timeout、canceled 结果使 job 失败。仍无法确认时成功退出，并输出 Actions warning 和醒目摘要；持久化状态保持 unknown，不标为完成。诊断 artifact 尽力归档，本地记录仍是恢复依据。模拟服务测试覆盖这些路径；发布操作者必须在生产依赖恢复能力前验证 COS/EdgeOne 权限、job-id 筛选、时间范围查询、任务类型和时间戳格式、Actions 跨 attempt 恢复及实际 CDN 行为。 解决故障后，仅在上文要求的上游输出完整时重跑失败的发布 job，以保持准备阶段选定的打包尝试；否则停止局部重试。新发布可显式选择原打包运行和尝试。尝试留空时重跑所有 job 会重新解析最新打包尝试，并需要重新审批。不要仅为重试上传而重新打包。缺失对象会上传，相同对象跳过，同名但字节不同的对象会停止操作。写入结果不明时通过读取远端字节核对。频道已有更高版本时，旧上传不能替换它。每个包只更新自身内置通道：nightly 写入 `nightly.yml` / `nightly-mac.yml`，stable 写入 `stable.yml` / `stable-mac.yml`。stable 二进制位于目标二进制前缀下的 `stable/` 子目录，与已有 nightly 对象分离。同一源码和版本发布到两个通道需要分别打包；已有发布 tag 仅在源码提交相同时复用。 同级 `upload-records/` 目录保留操作标识、逐行事件和最终结果。频道写入意图同时记录先前和目标 YAML。失败记录阶段、安全错误分类与诊断；COS 失败还标明 `GetObject` 或 `PutObject`，并在可用时记录经过校验的 HTTP 状态码和 request ID。访问拒绝提示会指出需检查的权限。不保存原始服务响应或凭据。审计初始化在文件完整后才可见；遗留的 `.initializing-*` 目录不参与已完成发布的扫描。写入和回读在继续操作前落盘；没有最终结果代表中断，不代表成功。Actions 还将操作记录保存为诊断 artifact，保留 30 天。这些本地记录不防篡改。COS 回读验证存储字节，不代表公开 CDN 行为；公开下载需单独验收。 频道更新完成但 tag 失败时，结果为 `published-tag-pending`，job 明确失败。重试时，已落盘的频道完成证据只允许恢复 tag，即使后来发布已推进频道，也不会重新发布旧 YAML。已有冲突 tag 需要管理员调查，不会自动移动。tag 创建被拒绝时保留其 HTTP 状态及经过校验的 GitHub request ID，后续查询不会用 tag 不存在的错误替换创建失败。仓库规则拒绝会提示操作人员检查匹配的 ruleset，不记录原始响应。 正常发布和手动恢复获取同一把本地频道锁。崩溃可能在同级 `publish-locks/` 下留下锁目录；手动删除前确认没有写入任务运行。runner 标签本身不能协调其他机器的写入。每个频道保持单一发布机器，迁移时保留记录。 ## 恢复频道 在发布机器上通过 `node --import tsx` 运行仓库脚本 `apps/desktop/scripts/rollback-desktop-channel.ts`。保持 `GITHUB_REPOSITORY`、`RUNNER_NAME`、`DSH_PACKAGING_CONFIG_DIR` 和 `DESKTOP_PUBLISH_ROUTE` 对应原打包上下文。route JSON 包含 `runId`、`attempt`、`commit`、`runnerName`、`target`、`preset`、`sourceRef` 和 `channel`，可从留存 manifest 的 source 字段取得。`--record` 指定该次成功发布的审计目录，`--expected-version` 指定当前线上版本，`--reason` 填写操作原因。 不带 `--execute` 时，脚本读取远端对象并打印确切 YAML 变更，不执行写入。预览需要 COS 读取凭据。带 `--execute` 时，脚本校验历史文件，将前后 YAML 保存在新的审计记录中，再次检查当前频道，然后仅恢复 YAML。它不上传二进制文件，也不改变 tag。已经与目标字节完全相同的频道会跳过，其余频道必须匹配预期当前版本，因此可以恢复写完一个 feed 后中断的操作。其他当前版本会中止操作。恢复不是多对象事务；部分失败后需先检查审计记录再继续。 Desktop 客户端禁用自动降级。恢复旧 feed 可以阻止更多客户端获得问题版本，已经安装更高版本的客户端不会降级。发布更高版本号的修正版是独立恢复方式。 ## 开发备注 无。

--- description: "Operator checklist for a Windows installed update with a failed download, explicit retry, and retained evidence." --- # Windows installed-update walkthrough English | [中文](README.zh.md) ## Summary Prepare a private test application and fresh test distribution namespace, then let the operator install, inject a fault, retry, and confirm restart. A local manifest or complete journal sequence does not certify an installer or preserved data. The installed-app steps below remain unverified until the operator performs them with verified packages. ## Table of Contents - [Prepare materials](#prepare) - [Operator sequence](#sequence) - [Evidence and recovery](#evidence) - [Dev Note](#dev-note) ## Prepare materials From the repository root with dependencies installed, allocate a run with two increasing derived test versions. This writes only an ignored local manifest; it does not build, sign, upload, install, or read credentials. The examples use base version `0.1.6-alpha.1`. Before creating new material, substitute the actual base, Asia/Shanghai date, and unused index according to the [release version rules](../../packaging/README.md#release-versions). ```powershell node --import tsx apps/desktop/scripts/prepare-installed-update.ts init 0.1.6-alpha.1.20260916.1 0.1.6-alpha.1.20260916.2 ``` Retain the returned `run.json` and reuse its random identity and `qualification/` paths for both packages. The source commit and dirty-file list identify the starting checkout, not the contents of a later package. Record final build source identifiers and artifact hashes separately; do not regenerate the manifest midway through an update. Prepare fresh source resources with the repository's preparation-only workflow, then generate the shared bootstrap, two private version-bound runtime copies, and frozen application files. Replace `` with the allocator's manifest path. Preparation-only builds and checks the source runtime but stops before signing; the other commands never invoke a signer or installer. These commands refuse to overwrite existing per-run outputs; retain partial material after an error instead of retrying over it. ```powershell node apps/desktop/node_modules/pnpm/bin/pnpm.mjs --dir apps/desktop run prepare:package win-x64 node --import tsx apps/desktop/scripts/prepare-installed-update.ts bootstrap "" node --import tsx apps/desktop/scripts/prepare-installed-update.ts runtime "" node --import tsx apps/desktop/scripts/prepare-installed-update.ts application "" ``` Package both files from the generated `bootstrap` directory beside `lib/`, and set the package main entry to `qualification-bootstrap.mjs`. That entry validates the installed application ID and version before loading production main. It assigns Electron user/session data, Harness home, and journals under the operating system's application-data directory at `dsh-update-qualification//`; both versions use the same paths. The runtime copier changes only release-family package versions and matching dependency references, preserves third-party versions, and re-verifies both copied inventories and the untouched source. Its `runtime-preparation/result.json` records hashes and explicitly does not claim signing or startup qualification of the copied versions. These synthetic versions are test materials, not npm releases. The `application` command copies built main/preload modules, renderer files, and the prepared bootstrap into `application/files`, with SHA-256 values in `application/result.json`. It does not copy the app's root `.env.windows` or freeze `node_modules` and build tools. The [qualification builder configuration](../../scripts/installed-update-builder.ts) verifies this inventory and the selected private runtime, selects the shared frozen files and isolated package metadata, and preserves ordinary installer and signing hooks. Its tests substitute the signer and pass the pinned builder's configuration validator; they do not produce an installer. A separately authorized supervised build must still record dependency/tool inputs and verify final package contents and signatures. The [packaging entry](../../scripts/package-installed-update.ts) defaults to checks. A retained signing interlock rejects before credentials are loaded; it never clears that interlock. With no interlock, checks load `.env.windows`, validate prepared inputs, and launch no child. The shared builder requires a valid `DOWNLOAD_TEST_RELEASE_ID` from the [test release settings](../../publishing/README.md#upload-updates); qualification still publishes through the manifest’s separate `qualification/` paths. Run this from the repository root with one exact version: ```powershell node --import tsx apps/desktop/scripts/package-installed-update.ts "" 0.1.6-alpha.1.20260916.1 --check ``` Actual packaging remains unverified and requires separate hardware-recovery approval and a present operator. The `--execute` mode requires a terminal and an exact confirmation containing the version and run ID; there is no piped approval option. It rechecks the interlock and exclusively allocates that version's `packaging` directory. The supervised child builds only that version, disables publication, strips unrelated credentials, and stops on failure or a 15-minute overall deadline. This deadline does not bound individual CSP authentication attempts. Records retain source/tool hashes, redacted output, events, and artifact file hashes; an existing attempt or output refuses reuse. `builderCompleted` and a successful supervisor result do not establish package verification, signature acceptance, or installation success; `packageVerification` remains `pending` until those checks are performed independently. Before the operator starts, supply both verified installers, generated metadata and blockmaps, packaging and signature records, the exact installed executable path, and fixed test feed URL. Both packages must use the same test identity, isolated data directories, and absolute external `DSH_DESKTOP_UPDATE_JOURNAL_DIR` on every launch, including an installer-triggered restart. A variable set only in the original launch terminal is insufficient. The [Windows signing rules](../../windows-signing/README.md#windows-ev-signing) still apply; a manifest never clears a signing interlock. The Windows [read-only signature helper](../../scripts/installed-update-signature.mjs) uses the real updater verifier with a publisher derived from the trusted public certificate, then requires valid Authenticode and timestamp attributes and unchanged SHA-512. Verification children receive no inherited signing/upload secrets or PowerShell module-path overrides. The helper never loads `.env.windows`, signs a file, or executes the inspected executable. Signed-probe acceptance and unsigned-installer rejection have been observed locally; they do not certify either prepared version, package identity, or installation behavior. The [package verifier](../../scripts/verify-installed-update-package.ts) checks the final installer before extracting it with a reviewed local 7-Zip executable. Supply absolute paths for the manifest, trusted public certificate, and tool; never select a tool extracted from the installer being verified. This command creates a fresh `verification/check-*` directory, preserves partial records, and fails immediately when the installer is absent: ```powershell node --import tsx apps/desktop/scripts/verify-installed-update-package.ts "" 0.1.6-alpha.1.20260916.1 "" "" ``` The verifier checks actual archived application identity, entry, frozen application bytes, updater dependency versions, feed/cache/publisher configuration, and the bundled Harness runtime against prepared inputs; the mandatory test policy must be valid. It extracts the runtime from `app.asar` and checks executable signatures at their `app.asar.unpacked` paths. Changed runtime executables require separate signature checks; other runtime bytes must match the prepared bytes after electron-builder's dependency-manifest transformation. It rejects unsafe archive paths before extraction and records installer, application, and runtime-executable signatures. Before success, it rechecks installer, feed/blockmap, manifest, certificate, and tool hashes. `passed` covers these checks only: dependency bytes are not frozen, and installer registration, startup, upgrade, and data retention remain explicit manual checks. Real archive reading has been observed on a retained older package; complete signed-package verification for the prepared versions remains pending. Follow the separate [upload and publication procedure](publication/README.md). Leave the fixed feed absent for the 404 case, then publish version 1 for the same-version case. Keep version 2 metadata local until both cases finish in the installed version 1 application. Retain publication records and remote objects for diagnosis; do not delete a published feed to recreate an earlier case. The local `files` command accepts `` and one exact run version. It reads that version's `installer/nightly.yml`, verifies the expected installer name, size, SHA-512, and nonempty external blockmap, and prints separate binary destinations and a fixed-feed body. Missing installers fail validation. It writes nothing and reads no credentials. Its `file-integrity-only` result cannot authorize upload or replace verification of signed package contents and application identity; those remain required before publication. ## Operator sequence Proceed manually only after preparation passes. Use disposable test conversations and settings, never a production workspace or unsaved work. 1. Install version 1. Record installer path, hash, signature result, and time. Start the installed shortcut and verify its executable path and displayed version; do not launch an unpacked build or development server. 2. Confirm version 1 `started` and `workspace-ready` in a new journal. Create an identifiable test conversation and change a harmless setting; record expected values privately. Complete the two feed checks below and keep version 1 running. - **Missing feed:** retain a timestamped GET of the configured fixed URL returning 404. Observe startup automatic checking without a disruptive dialog, then manually check: expect checking followed by failure, not “no updates,” and no download or installation. Save screenshots and journals before publishing anything. - **Same-version feed:** after separate authorization, publish version 1 to that same URL and retain the complete 200 response, version, and SHA-512. Check manually in the still-running version 1: expect no available update and its current version, no download or installation, and no stale error indicator from the 404 case. Automatic no-update checking must remain quiet. Retain evidence before authorizing version 2. 3. Authorize version 2 metadata publication at the existing fixed feed URL. Re-read that URL and verify version 2 and its binary hash. Preserve publication evidence after version 1 startup evidence. 4. In version 1, check manually and confirm availability without automatic download. Prepare the reviewed [application-scoped fault and recovery](network/README.md). Never disable the adapter, VPN, shared proxy, remote-control connection, or domain-wide access. 5. Click download and interrupt only the test application's transfer after progress begins. Capture one failure and persistent retry feedback; confirm no installation or silent retry. A connection failure before progress begins is a different observation and does not satisfy a transfer-interruption test. 6. Remove the exact run-owned fault and verify recovery. Click retry yourself. Record progress, verification, and readiness. Expect a separate installation confirmation; download completion alone must not approve restart. 7. Confirm installation. With active tasks, inspect the warning and explicitly authorize stopping them; without tasks, the confirmation must not claim tasks exist. Record the last version 1 window and let installation and restart finish without manually starting another instance. 8. Verify the installed version 2 executable and displayed version. Check the conversation and setting from step 2 and capture the result. Find version 2 `started` and `workspace-ready` in the same external evidence directory. Report missing automatic restart separately from successful manual startup; one cannot substitute for the other. ## Evidence and recovery The intentional 404 is a check-failure case, not the later interrupted-download case. A browser response alone does not prove application behavior. Keep each observation's URL, UTC time, HTTP status, feed body/hash when present, screenshot, and journal snapshot together. The journal inspector does not certify the two feed cases or record raw HTTP diagnostics; the operator supplies those observations. A later successful manual check must recover without restarting the application. Retain the manifest, build records, original feeds, binary hashes, publication receipts and readbacks, fault setup/removal evidence, screenshots, and all process journals. Installer logs and test data may contain private paths or content; review before sharing. The inspector is read-only and copies only milestone references, not raw diagnostics. Replace the directory placeholder and use the manifest's exact versions: ```powershell node --import tsx apps/desktop/scripts/prepare-installed-update.ts inspect 0.1.6-alpha.1.20260916.1 0.1.6-alpha.1.20260916.2 "" ``` Exit 0 means the ordered journal milestones are present; exit 2 means missing milestones; exit 1 means input or command validation failed. A failure/retry sequence cannot combine different version 1 processes. A successor started before the original process quit is not counted; clock changes can leave evidence incomplete and require investigation. `recordedFlow: complete` is not overall acceptance. The report always requires independent operator checks for publication timing, network failure and recovery, installer completion and path, preserved data, and screenshots and confirmations. To retain a local journal snapshot and its report, use `collect` with the matching installed application's `dsh-update-qualification//journals` directory. It validates all selected records before creating a fresh `evidence/collection-*` under the material run. The copied journals and `report.json` describe the same in-memory snapshot, with SHA-256 values and `operatorAcceptance: pending`; original files are unchanged. Other files, settings, conversations, build output, and credentials are not collected. Keep their separately reviewed evidence alongside the report, not inside the journal directory. ```powershell node --import tsx apps/desktop/scripts/prepare-installed-update.ts collect "" "" ``` Collection exit 0 means files were saved, even if the recorded flow is incomplete; inspect `report.json` before drawing conclusions. Failed writes retain partial output and a failure marker when storage permits. Repeated collection creates another directory without replacing earlier evidence. Inspection and collection reject partial tails, unknown fields or diagnostic values, files over 10 MiB, and snapshots over 50 MiB. Collect after the relevant actions settle; a live application can append records after the snapshot, and a racing partial append requires a later collection rather than truncating the original log. Real installed-app collection remains an operator step; tests use the actual journal writer with synthetic lifecycle actions. Use this report template; leave unobserved results pending: | Item | Evidence location | Result | |---|---|---| | Both installers and signatures verified | | pending | | Feed 404: automatic quiet failure and manual visible failure, no download | | pending | | Version 1 feed: no available update in running version 1, prior error cleared | | pending | | Version 1 running before version 2 publication | | pending | | Test-only fault and observed download failure | | pending | | Fault removed and explicit retry reached readiness | | pending | | Separate confirmation and installer completion | | pending | | Automatic restart into installed version 2 | | pending | | Test conversation and setting preserved | | pending | | Journals and screenshots retained | | pending | | Test network changes absent afterward | | pending | Stop at the first failed prerequisite. Signing failure stops packaging and preserves its record; do not retry PIN authentication automatically. A feed mismatch stops the test before download. If a fault affects remote control, stop and restore only its owned change with the prepared recovery action. Do not uninstall, clear caches, delete evidence, or overwrite failed batches to make a later attempt appear successful. Allocate a new run for a clean attempt and retain the failed one. ## Dev Note Local allocation and journal inspection have automated tests. Signed package production, isolated network-fault tooling, late feed publication, installer-triggered restart, and this full operator sequence require separate qualification; this page does not report them as completed.

--- description: "Windows 已安装应用更新的人工清单，覆盖下载失败、显式重试与证据保留。" --- # Windows 已安装应用更新演练 [English](README.md) | 中文 ## 摘要 准备独立测试应用和全新的 test 分发命名空间，再由操作者亲手安装、注入故障、重试并确认重启。本地清单或完整日志序列不能证明安装器合格或数据保留。下述已安装应用步骤在操作者使用已验证安装包执行之前仍未验证。 ## 目录 - [准备物料](#prepare) - [人工操作顺序](#sequence) - [证据与恢复](#evidence) - [开发备注](#dev-note) ## 准备物料 在已安装依赖的仓库根目录中，用两个递增的派生测试版本创建批次。这只写入已忽略的本地清单，不构建、签名、上传、安装或读取凭据。 示例以 `0.1.6-alpha.1` 为基础版本。创建新物料前，按[发布版本规则](../../packaging/README.zh.md#release-versions)替换为实际基础版本、北京时间日期和未使用的序号。 ```powershell node --import tsx apps/desktop/scripts/prepare-installed-update.ts init 0.1.6-alpha.1.20260916.1 0.1.6-alpha.1.20260916.2 ``` 保留返回的 `run.json`，两个安装包复用其中的随机身份与 `qualification/` 路径。源提交与脏文件列表标识起始工作区，不代表后续安装包内容。最终构建来源和产物哈希另行记录；不要在更新中途重新生成清单。 通过仓库的仅准备流程生成新源码资源，再生成共享启动入口、两份独立的版本绑定运行时和冻结的应用文件。将 `` 替换为批次清单路径。仅准备流程构建并检查原始运行时，但在签名前停止；其余命令绝不调用签名器或安装器。这些命令拒绝覆盖已有批次产物；出错后保留不完整物料，不在其上重试。 ```powershell node apps/desktop/node_modules/pnpm/bin/pnpm.mjs --dir apps/desktop run prepare:package win-x64 node --import tsx apps/desktop/scripts/prepare-installed-update.ts bootstrap "" node --import tsx apps/desktop/scripts/prepare-installed-update.ts runtime "" node --import tsx apps/desktop/scripts/prepare-installed-update.ts application "" ``` 将生成的 `bootstrap` 目录中的两个文件放在包内 `lib/` 同级，将包主入口设为 `qualification-bootstrap.mjs`。该入口在加载生产主程序前验证已安装应用的 ID 与版本。它将 Electron 用户/会话数据、Harness home 和日志放在操作系统应用数据目录下的 `dsh-update-qualification//`；两个版本使用相同路径。运行时复制器仅修改发布家族包版本和对应依赖引用，保留第三方版本，并重新校验两个副本清单和未修改的原始资源。其 `runtime-preparation/result.json` 记录哈希，并明确不宣称签名或副本版本的启动验收通过。这些合成版本属于测试物料，不是 npm 发布版本。 `application` 命令将已构建的主程序/预加载模块、界面文件和准备好的启动入口复制到 `application/files`，并在 `application/result.json` 中记录 SHA-256。它不复制应用根目录的 `.env.windows`，也不冻结 `node_modules` 与构建工具。[验收打包配置](../../scripts/installed-update-builder.ts)校验该清单与选定的独立运行时，选用共享冻结文件和隔离包元数据，并保留常规安装器与签名钩子。其测试替换签名器，并通过固定版本构建器的配置校验；测试不生成安装器。另行授权的受监督构建仍须记录依赖/工具输入，并验证最终包内容及签名。 [打包入口](../../scripts/package-installed-update.ts)默认只检查。保留的签名保护锁会在读取凭据前使其拒绝；入口绝不清除此锁。没有保护锁时，检查会加载 `.env.windows`、校验准备输入，不启动子进程。共享构建器要求[测试发布配置](../../publishing/README.zh.md#upload-updates)中有效的 `DOWNLOAD_TEST_RELEASE_ID`；资格验收仍使用清单中独立的 `qualification/` 路径发布。在仓库根目录使用一个准确版本执行： ```powershell node --import tsx apps/desktop/scripts/package-installed-update.ts "" 0.1.6-alpha.1.20260916.1 --check ``` 实际打包仍未验证，必须另行获得硬件恢复授权并有操作者在场。`--execute` 模式要求终端和包含版本、批次 ID 的准确确认，没有管道批准选项。它再次检查保护锁，并独占创建该版本的 `packaging` 目录。受监督子进程只构建该版本、禁用发布、移除无关凭据，失败或达到 15 分钟整体期限时停止。该期限不限制单次 CSP 内部认证尝试。记录保留源码/工具哈希、脱敏输出、事件和产物文件哈希；已有尝试或输出拒绝复用。`builderCompleted` 与监督程序成功结果不证明包验证、验签或安装成功；独立完成这些检查前，`packageVerification` 保持 `pending`。 操作者开始前，提供两个已验证安装包、生成的元数据与 blockmap、打包和签名记录、准确的安装后可执行文件路径与固定 test feed URL。两个安装包必须使用相同的测试身份、隔离数据目录，并在每次启动时设置同一个安装目录外的绝对路径 `DSH_DESKTOP_UPDATE_JOURNAL_DIR`，包括安装器触发的重启。仅在首次启动终端中设置变量是不够的。[Windows 签名规则](../../windows-signing/README.zh.md#windows-ev-signing)仍适用；清单绝不解除签名保护锁。 Windows [只读签名检查器](../../scripts/installed-update-signature.mjs)使用真实 updater 验签，发布者来自可信公钥证书，随后要求 Authenticode 与时间戳属性有效且 SHA-512 未变。验签子进程不继承签名/上传秘密或 PowerShell 模块路径覆盖。检查器绝不加载 `.env.windows`、签名文件或执行被检查的可执行文件。本地已观察到签名探针通过、未签名安装包被拒绝；这些结果不能证明任一准备版本、包身份或安装行为已验收。 [安装包检查器](../../scripts/verify-installed-update-package.ts)先校验最终安装包，再使用经过审查的本地 7-Zip 可执行文件解包。清单、可信公钥证书和工具均须提供绝对路径；绝不选择从待验安装包中解出的工具。此命令创建全新的 `verification/check-*` 目录，保留部分记录，安装包缺失时立即失败： ```powershell node --import tsx apps/desktop/scripts/verify-installed-update-package.ts "" 0.1.6-alpha.1.20260916.1 "" "" ``` 检查器核对实际归档内的应用身份、入口、冻结应用字节、updater 依赖版本、feed/缓存/发布者配置，并将内置 Harness 运行时与准备输入比较；测试强更策略也必须有效。它从 `app.asar` 提取运行时，并在 `app.asar.unpacked` 路径核对可执行文件签名。发生变化的运行时可执行文件须单独验签；其他运行时字节在经过 electron-builder 的依赖 manifest 转换后必须与准备输入一致。它在解包前拒绝不安全归档路径，记录安装器、应用及运行时可执行文件的签名。成功前再次核对安装包、feed/blockmap、清单、证书和工具哈希。`passed` 仅覆盖这些检查：依赖字节未冻结，安装器注册、启动、升级和数据保留仍是明确的人工检查项。保留的旧包已完成真实归档读取；本批次准备版本的完整签名包检查仍待执行。 遵循独立的[上传与发布步骤](publication/README.zh.md)。先保持固定 feed 不存在以测试 404，再发布版本 1 以测试同版本。两个场景在已安装的版本 1 应用内完成之前，版本 2 元数据保留在本地。保留发布记录及远端对象用于诊断，不删除已发布的 feed 来重建较早场景。 本地 `files` 命令接受 `` 与本批次的一个准确版本。它读取该版本的 `installer/nightly.yml`，验证预期安装包文件名、大小、SHA-512 和非空外部 blockmap，输出分开的二进制目标与固定 feed 内容。安装包缺失会导致验证失败。它不写文件，也不读取凭据。其 `file-integrity-only` 结果不能授权上传，也不能替代签名包内容和应用身份验证；这些仍是发布前的必要条件。 ## 人工操作顺序 仅在准备通过后亲手操作。使用可丢弃的测试会话和设置，不使用生产工作区或未保存的工作。 1. 安装版本 1。记录安装包路径、哈希、签名结果和时间。通过安装后的快捷方式启动，核对可执行文件路径与界面版本；不要启动解包目录中的应用或开发服务器。 2. 确认新日志包含版本 1 的 `started` 和 `workspace-ready`。创建可辨认的测试会话并修改一项无害设置，在本地记录预期值。完成下面两项 feed 检查，并保持版本 1 运行。 - **清单缺失：**保留对配置的固定 URL 执行 GET 返回 404 的带时间戳记录。观察启动自动检查不弹出打扰性弹窗，再手动检查：预期先检查、后提示失败，而非“暂无更新”，且不下载、不安装。发布任何清单前先保存截图和日志。 - **同版本清单：**另行授权后将版本 1 发布到相同 URL，保留完整的 200 响应、版本与 SHA-512。在仍运行的版本 1 内手动检查：预期显示暂无可用更新及当前版本，不下载、不安装，且不残留此前 404 的错误图标。自动检查无更新时应静默。授权版本 2 前先保留证据。 3. 授权将版本 2 元数据发布到已有的固定 feed URL。回读该 URL，验证版本 2 及其二进制哈希。保留晚于版本 1 启动证据的发布证据。 4. 在版本 1 中手动检查，确认提示可用版本但不自动下载。准备经过审查的[仅针对测试应用的故障与恢复](network/README.zh.md)。绝不禁用网卡、VPN、共享代理、远控连接或整个域名的访问。 5. 点击下载，在进度开始后仅中断测试应用的传输。截取一次失败与持续重试提示，确认不安装或静默重试。进度开始前的连接失败是另一种观测，不能满足传输中断测试。 6. 移除本批次的准确故障设置并验证恢复。亲手点击重试。记录进度、校验和就绪。预期出现独立安装确认；下载完成本身不得授权重启。 7. 确认安装。有任务时检查警告并显式授权停止；没有任务时，确认内容不得声称存在任务。记录版本 1 最后的窗口，让安装和重启自然结束，不手动启动另一实例。 8. 验证安装后的版本 2 可执行文件与界面版本。检查第 2 步的会话和设置并截图。在同一外部证据目录中找到版本 2 的 `started` 和 `workspace-ready`。自动重启缺失与手动启动成功分开报告，二者不能互相替代。 ## 证据与恢复 故意保留的 404 属于检查失败，不是后续的下载中断场景。仅有浏览器响应不能证明应用行为。每次观测的 URL、UTC 时间、HTTP 状态、存在时的 feed 原文及哈希、截图和日志快照应一同保存。日志检查器不认证这两个 feed 场景，也不记录原始 HTTP 诊断；这些观察结果由操作者提供。后续手动检查成功应无需重启应用即可恢复。 保留清单、构建记录、原始 feed、二进制哈希、发布回执与回读、故障设置和移除证据、截图及全部进程日志。安装器日志与测试数据可能包含私有路径或内容，分享前须审查。检查器只读，仅复制里程碑引用，不复制原始诊断。替换目录占位符并使用清单中的准确版本： ```powershell node --import tsx apps/desktop/scripts/prepare-installed-update.ts inspect 0.1.6-alpha.1.20260916.1 0.1.6-alpha.1.20260916.2 "" ``` 退出码 0 表示按序日志标记齐全；退出码 2 表示缺少标记；退出码 1 表示输入或命令验证失败。失败重试序列不能拼接不同版本 1 进程。早于原进程退出就启动的后继进程不计入；系统时间变化可能导致证据不完整，需要调查。`recordedFlow: complete` 不等于整体验收通过。报告始终要求独立人工检查发布时间、网络失败与恢复、安装器完成与路径、数据保留以及截图和确认。 使用 `collect` 及匹配安装应用的 `dsh-update-qualification//journals` 目录保存本地日志快照与报告。它先验证所有选中记录，再在物料批次下创建新的 `evidence/collection-*`。复制的日志与 `report.json` 描述同一份内存快照，包含 SHA-256 和 `operatorAcceptance: pending`；原文件保持不变。不收集其他文件、设置、会话、构建输出或凭据。将这些另外审查过的证据与报告一同保留，不放进日志目录。 ```powershell node --import tsx apps/desktop/scripts/prepare-installed-update.ts collect "" "" ``` 收集退出码 0 表示文件已保存，即使记录流程不完整；下结论前检查 `report.json`。写入失败时保留部分输出，并在存储允许时留下失败标记。重复收集创建新目录，不替换旧证据。检查和收集拒绝不完整结尾、未知字段或诊断值、超过 10 MiB 的文件及超过 50 MiB 的快照。相关操作稳定后再收集；运行中的应用可能在快照之后追加记录，竞争中的不完整追加要求稍后再收集，不能截断原日志。真实安装应用的收集仍需人工执行；测试使用真实日志写入器和合成生命周期操作。 使用下表记录结果，未观测项保留待验证： | 项目 | 证据位置 | 结果 | |---|---|---| | 两个安装包及签名已验证 | | 待验证 | | feed 404：自动静默失败、手动可见失败且不下载 | | 待验证 | | 版本 1 feed：运行中的版本 1 无可用更新，旧错误已清除 | | 待验证 | | 版本 1 运行早于版本 2 发布 | | 待验证 | | 仅测试应用故障且观察到下载失败 | | 待验证 | | 故障移除后显式重试达到就绪 | | 待验证 | | 独立确认与安装器完成 | | 待验证 | | 自动重启到已安装的版本 2 | | 待验证 | | 测试会话与设置保留 | | 待验证 | | 日志与截图保留 | | 待验证 | | 结束后不存在测试网络改动 | | 待验证 | 首个前置条件失败时即停止。签名失败终止打包并保留记录，不自动重试 PIN 认证。feed 不符则在下载前停止测试。故障影响远控时停止，并通过准备好的恢复动作仅还原其拥有的改动。不要卸载、清缓存、删除证据或覆盖失败批次，让后续尝试看起来成功。需要全新尝试时新建批次，并保留失败批次。 ## 开发备注 本地批次创建与日志检查已有自动化测试。签名产物生成、隔离网络故障工具、延后 feed 发布、安装器触发重启和完整人工流程仍需单独验收；本页不将其报告为已完成。

--- description: "Windows signing concurrency measurements and retesting on replacement runners." --- # Windows signing concurrency qualification English | [中文](README.zh.md) ## Summary Use this record when choosing signing concurrency on a replacement Windows runner. Results apply to the measured host, token and software combination; repeat qualification after changing them. Production signing remains serial. ## Table of Contents - [Retest on another machine](#retest-on-another-machine) - [Measured reference](#measured-reference) ## Retest on another machine 1. Follow the [operator-approved experiment procedure](../../windows-signing/README.md#verification), using a hash-pinned corpus of real runtime, application and installer files. Compare the same inputs across modes; preserve originals and use isolated copies without signature-cache reuse. 2. Run `--corpus` with `--rounds 2` to compare 1/1, 2/2 and 4/4 completion workers/hardware requests, reversing the second round. Run the same corpus with `--pipeline-control --rounds 2` for the 4/1 control. Retain the procedure's first-failure stop and interlock handling. 3. Record the date, test and artifact versions, corpus count/bytes/largest file, CPU/RAM/disk, token/client/provider/SignTool versions, timestamp service, competing jobs and resource pressure. Keep both batch wall times and failure/retry counts; retain detailed output outside Git without credentials. Select a candidate only from completely verified runs, then validate it in the complete signed release workflow. Similar results favor fewer hardware requests; unexpected variation needs more rounds. ## Measured reference On 2026-10-22, the experiment in PR #6675 used retained files from release run 39725804188, version `0.2.1-rc.2.20261022.50.2`. Each batch contained 148 runtime and 8 application/installer targets: 156 files, 849.2 MiB unsigned, largest 277.5 MiB. Deleted transient targets and repeated intermediate signing passes were excluded. The host had a Ryzen AI 9 HX 470 (12 cores/24 threads), 32 GiB RAM and a 1 TB UMIS RPJYJ1T24RLS1QWY disk. The operator identified the token as SafeNet 5110; the precise variant/firmware was not verified. Signing used SafeNet Authentication Client 10.9.4482.0, `eToken Base Cryptographic Provider` and the unchanged machine test preset's SignTool/timestamp service. Public signature removal alone used SDK 10.0.26100.0 SignTool. Mode-average host CPU was 7.6–8.9%, minimum sampled free RAM was 9.9 GiB, and no Runner.Worker was sampled; other Node processes shared the host. Times below are batch wall seconds, including signing, timestamp completion and all file verification. They exclude preparation, lock waiting, build, cache lookup, package assembly and upload. File-system caches were uncontrolled; these are not cold/hot full-release measurements. | Completion workers / hardware requests | Round 1 (s) | Round 2 (s) | Mean (s) | Reduction vs serial | |---|---:|---:|---:|---:| | 1 / 1 | 732.3 | 718.5 | 725.4 | — | | 2 / 2 | 398.3 | 394.6 | 396.5 | 45.3% | | 4 / 4 | 459.4 | 465.0 | 462.2 | 36.3% | | 4 / 1, separate control | 427.7 | 428.3 | 428.0 | 41.0% | All 1,248 signatures, timestamps and final validations passed, with zero hardware failures/timeouts or timestamp retries. Original files and signature-cache payloads remained unchanged. The 2/2 mode was fastest; 4/4 was slower, while pipeline overlap alone delivered most of the observed benefit. This selects candidates for further release testing, not a production default or evidence of parallel operations inside the token. It does not establish a ten-minute complete release. ## Dev Note None.

--- description: "Windows 签名并发实测结果与更换 runner 后的复测方法。" --- # Windows 签名并发验收 [English](README.md) | 中文 ## 摘要 更换 Windows runner 后，使用本记录选择签名并发参数。结果仅适用于实测的主机、UKey 和软件组合；更换后需重新验收。生产签名仍为串行。 ## 目录 - [在另一台机器上复测](#retest-on-another-machine) - [实测参考](#measured-reference) ## 在另一台机器上复测 1. 按[经操作人员授权的实验流程](../../windows-signing/README.zh.md#verification)，使用哈希固定的真实 runtime、应用和安装器文件集。各模式使用相同输入，保留原件，使用隔离副本且不复用签名缓存。 2. 使用 `--corpus` 和 `--rounds 2` 比较完成任务数/硬件请求数为 1/1、2/2、4/4 的模式，第二轮反转顺序。对相同文件集使用 `--pipeline-control --rounds 2` 测量 4/1 对照组。保留流程中的首错停止和 interlock 处理。 3. 记录日期、测试及产物版本、文件数/总大小/最大文件、CPU/内存/磁盘、UKey/客户端/provider/SignTool 版本、时间戳服务、并行任务和资源压力。保留两轮整批墙钟时间及失败/重试次数；详细输出保存在 Git 外且不含凭据。仅从全部验证通过的结果中选择候选参数，再用完整签名发布流程验收。结果接近时优先减少硬件请求；波动异常时增加轮次。 ## 实测参考 2026-10-22，PR #6675 中的实验使用发布 run 39725804188 保留的文件，版本为 `0.2.1-rc.2.20261022.50.2`。每批包含 148 个 runtime 和 8 个应用/安装器签名目标：共 156 个文件，无签名总大小 849.2 MiB，最大文件 277.5 MiB。不含已删除的临时目标及中间产物的重复签名调用。 主机使用 Ryzen AI 9 HX 470（12 核/24 线程）、32 GiB 内存和 1 TB UMIS RPJYJ1T24RLS1QWY 磁盘。操作人员确认 UKey 为 SafeNet 5110，未核实具体变体/固件。签名使用 SafeNet Authentication Client 10.9.4482.0、`eToken Base Cryptographic Provider`，以及未变更的机器 test preset 中的 SignTool/时间戳服务。仅公开移除签名使用 SDK 10.0.26100.0 SignTool。各模式主机平均 CPU 为 7.6–8.9%，采样可用内存最低 9.9 GiB，未采样到 Runner.Worker；另有 Node 进程共享主机。 下表为整批墙钟秒数，包含签名、时间戳完成及全部文件验证。不含准备、等锁、构建、缓存查询、包组装和上传。文件系统缓存未受控，因此不是完整发布的冷/热缓存测量。 | 完成任务数 / 硬件请求数 | 第 1 轮（秒） | 第 2 轮（秒） | 平均（秒） | 相对串行减少 | |---|---:|---:|---:|---:| | 1 / 1 | 732.3 | 718.5 | 725.4 | — | | 2 / 2 | 398.3 | 394.6 | 396.5 | 45.3% | | 4 / 4 | 459.4 | 465.0 | 462.2 | 36.3% | | 4 / 1，单独对照组 | 427.7 | 428.3 | 428.0 | 41.0% | 共 1,248 次签名、时间戳及最终验证全部通过，硬件失败/超时及时间戳重试均为零。原文件和签名缓存内容保持不变。2/2 模式最快，4/4 更慢；仅流水线重叠已获得大部分实测收益。这些结果用于选择后续发布测试的候选参数，不是生产默认值，也不能证明 UKey 内部并行执行。它们不能证明完整发布达到十分钟。 ## 开发备注 无。

# Embedded DSH IM runtime

This directory contains MIT-licensed source from [xmanrui/dsh-im](https://github.com/xmanrui/dsh-im), pinned to commit `fc2ceab217309f8973afa03c58cdd8ff3e900130`. That checkout declares version 5.10.0 but differs from the npm 5.10.0 tarball. `LICENSE` preserves the author's notice; `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` preserves bundled dependency and artwork notices.

The runtime is compiled into `@ipollo/dsh-suite/im`; it is not published or installed as another bundle. No upstream executable is included. The suite owns release updates. Existing channel configuration paths and credential references remain unchanged, so switching from the standalone bundle does not require recreating bot accounts. The standalone bundle must be disabled first; the suite refuses duplicate activation.

## Local changes

- Host context sharing uses the public `Context.root` symbol so current Cordis does not interpret `root` as an undeclared service.

- `plugin-src/host/index.mjs` and `plugin-src/client/index.js`: remove standalone update handlers and controls. The client uses the suite's package metadata and navigation IDs.
- `plugin-src/host/harness-session-coordinator.mjs`: retain received media with native DSH file uploads and reuse the optional native speech service through `src/host/im-media.ts` in the suite. Provider or converter errors retain recordings and publish only a safe status.
- `src/channels/shared/inbound-file.mjs`: carry platform transcripts, emit native file receipt parts, and omit receipt IDs from model text. Images use normal native image input, or a retained file when the selected model refuses images.
- DingTalk, Feishu, WeCom, and WeCom application adapters: preserve available audio download references and transcripts. WeCom intelligent-bot callbacks normally supply a transcript without the recording; the adapter does not manufacture missing audio.
- `plugin-src/client/plugin-page.js`: use suite-owned navigation IDs.
- `plugin-src/client/styles.js`: keep channel selection in a horizontally scrolling row on small screens so the selected settings remain visible.
- `plugin-src/client/credential-binding.js` and `plugin-src/client/channels/shared/token-channel.js`: present shared and channel-specific credential forms in the native modal instead of expanding secret fields inside the channel page. Existing submission callbacks and storage remain unchanged.

Other source remains upstream code. Selected upstream media-delivery and image-input tests accompany the source. Review these changes explicitly when advancing the pinned commit; the Lark SDK build patch fails if its expected SDK source changes.

## Menu integration

The local `menu-introduction.mjs` helper adds one-time, access-checked private-chat guidance using the existing channel state. Channel state readers preserve its optional `menuIntroductions` field. The DingTalk, WeCom, WeChat, QQ, and Feishu bridges reuse their existing command handlers; their first input is not replaced by the guide. Native Feishu and Telegram command panels retain their upstream registration logic.

`wecom-app/menu.mjs` and the application's API/runtime add native bottom-menu registration, preserve foreign menus, and dispatch a fixed whitelist of click keys. Missing registration uses the same first-chat guide. WeCom intelligent-bot entry callbacks use the SDK's welcome-reply API without waiting for model or workspace catalogs.

## Main assistant entry

Channel configuration carries the suite's effective `entryAgentPreset` into the shared workspace store. Its runtime override preserves stored defaults and existing bound Sessions, while new QR/automatic connections create coordinator Sessions. The native preset catalog remains unchanged outside IM; IM displays the coordinator as its fixed entry. The shared client completion hook waits for native coordinator descendants and returns the final root answer, preserving cancellation and errors. These changes add no persisted fields. Recheck this hook, each production constructor, and the preset editor when updating the vendor source.

--- description: "Operator-owned Windows network fault and recovery for one verified installed update test application." --- # Test-application network fault English | [中文](README.zh.md) ## Summary Interrupt only the installed qualification application's outbound traffic, then remove that exact rule before retrying the update. The tools never disable an adapter, VPN, proxy, or firewall profile. Real traffic interruption remains an operator observation; tests substitute all firewall cmdlets. ## Table of Contents - [Prepare](#prepare) - [Block and restore](#operate) - [Evidence and limitations](#evidence) - [Dev Note](#dev-note) ## Prepare Complete version 1 package verification and install that version through the [walkthrough](../README.md). Supply the installed executable, not the extracted payload. From the repository root, prepare its plan: ```powershell node --import tsx apps/desktop/scripts/prepare-installed-update-network.ts "" "" "" ``` The preparer requires version 1 identity and signature evidence, the exact test filename, and matching executable bytes. It resolves Windows short paths and refuses executables inside the material run. It exclusively writes `network-fault/plan.json` without changing network state. Retain the original plan; it identifies the one removable rule. Installation registration still requires independent operator verification. ## Block and restore These are pending manual steps, not a report of real firewall qualification. Use an administrator terminal and prepare a second terminal with the Restore command before blocking. Each invocation writes a new record. `Status` is the default and does not change firewall state. The execution-policy option affects only this PowerShell process; it does not change system policy. ```powershell powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File apps/desktop/scripts/installed-update-network.ps1 -Plan "" -Action Status powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File apps/desktop/scripts/installed-update-network.ps1 -Plan "" -Action Block powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File apps/desktop/scripts/installed-update-network.ps1 -Plan "" -Action Restore ``` Start Block, leave its confirmation waiting, then start the download. After positive progress, type the displayed `BLOCK ` confirmation. The script rechecks executable bytes and rule absence before creating one program-specific outbound block. Observe and capture an actual failed download; rule creation alone is insufficient. Run Restore and type `RESTORE ` to remove the matching rule, then click retry yourself. Status must report the rule absent. Never change unrelated rules to force a failure. ## Evidence and limitations The script flushes timestamped stages and final success/failure into `network-fault/records//events.jsonl`. It stops on errors and never retries or silently removes a rule after failed creation. Run Restore explicitly after any uncertain result. Recovery validates the rule's name, ownership description, direction, action, and exact program path; it does not require the executable to still exist. An absent rule is a safe no-op; a foreign matching rule is not removed. Windows supports [program-specific outbound rules](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/security/operating-system-security/network-security/windows-firewall/configure-with-command-line). Local policy, existing connections, and a download finishing before confirmation can prevent the intended interruption. A rule in PersistentStore does not prove effective traffic blocking. Keep the application open and observe its failure and subsequent successful retry; if either is absent, record the attempt as incomplete. The rule persists until removed, including across restart. Keep the plan and recovery terminal available; never install the update with the test rule still present. ## Dev Note Local plan validation and the actual PowerShell control flow have inert tests. Real rule creation, effective interruption, and recovery require the operator's authorized installed-app run.

--- description: "由操作者控制的 Windows 网络故障与恢复，仅针对已验证的安装版更新测试应用。" --- # 测试应用网络故障 [English](README.md) | 中文 ## 摘要 仅中断已安装验收应用的出站流量，再移除该准确规则后重试更新。工具绝不禁用网卡、VPN、代理或防火墙配置文件。真实流量中断仍须由操作者观察；测试替换了全部防火墙命令。 ## 目录 - [准备](#prepare) - [阻断与恢复](#operate) - [证据与局限](#evidence) - [开发备注](#dev-note) ## 准备 按照[演练指南](../README.zh.md)完成版本 1 安装包验证并安装该版本。提供已安装可执行文件，而非解包产物。在仓库根目录准备计划： ```powershell node --import tsx apps/desktop/scripts/prepare-installed-update-network.ts "" "" "" ``` 准备器要求版本 1 身份与签名证据、准确的测试文件名以及匹配的可执行文件字节。它解析 Windows 短路径，拒绝物料批次目录内的可执行文件。它独占写入 `network-fault/plan.json`，不改变网络状态。保留原始计划，它标识唯一可移除的规则。安装注册仍须操作者独立验证。 ## 阻断与恢复 以下是待执行的人工步骤，不是真实防火墙验收通过报告。使用管理员终端，并在阻断前准备第二个终端及 Restore 命令。每次调用写入新记录。`Status` 是默认动作，不改变防火墙状态。执行策略选项只影响本次 PowerShell 进程，不修改系统策略。 ```powershell powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File apps/desktop/scripts/installed-update-network.ps1 -Plan "" -Action Status powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File apps/desktop/scripts/installed-update-network.ps1 -Plan "" -Action Block powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File apps/desktop/scripts/installed-update-network.ps1 -Plan "" -Action Restore ``` 启动 Block，停留在确认提示，再开始下载。出现正进度后，输入提示中的 `BLOCK ` 确认。脚本再次检查可执行文件字节与规则不存在，再创建一条指定程序的出站阻断规则。观察并截取实际下载失败；仅创建规则不够。执行 Restore 并输入 `RESTORE `，移除匹配规则，再亲手点击重试。Status 必须报告规则不存在。绝不修改无关规则来强行制造失败。 ## 证据与局限 脚本将带时间的阶段及最终成功/失败刷入 `network-fault/records//events.jsonl`。出错即停，绝不重试，也不在创建失败后静默删除规则。结果不确定时显式运行 Restore。恢复检查规则名、归属说明、方向、动作和准确程序路径，不要求可执行文件仍存在。规则不存在时安全地不操作；不会移除匹配名称的外来规则。 Windows 支持[指定程序的出站规则](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/security/operating-system-security/network-security/windows-firewall/configure-with-command-line)。本地策略、已有连接或确认前下载已结束，都可能使预期中断没有发生。PersistentStore 中有规则不证明流量确实被阻断。保持应用打开，观察其失败以及后续成功重试；任一现象缺失都将本次尝试记录为未完成。规则会持续存在直至移除，重启也不会自动删除。保留计划和恢复终端；测试规则仍存在时绝不安装更新。 ## 开发备注 本地计划验证与实际 PowerShell 控制流程已有无网络改动测试。真实规则创建、有效中断与恢复须由操作者在获准的已安装应用演练中执行。

--- description: "Separate test binary uploads from operator-authorized fixed-feed publication for installed Windows update qualification." --- # Test update upload and publication English | [中文](README.zh.md) ## Summary Upload both verified versions without advertising version 2, then publish its fixed feed after the operator starts installed version 1. Default commands check local materials without credentials or network access. Actual COS writes require separate operator authorization and verification. ## Table of Contents - [Prerequisites](#prerequisites) - [Operator sequence](#sequence) - [Evidence and recovery](#evidence) - [Dev Note](#dev-note) ## Prerequisites Complete both package verifications in the [walkthrough](../README.md). Retain successful `verification/check-*/result.json` receipts and unchanged materials. The publisher revalidates each receipt against current installer, blockmap, feed, and manifest bytes. It never signs or installs anything. The existing `.env.windows` loader supplies `DSH_DESKTOP_AUTO_UPDATE_ENV=test`, `DOWNLOAD_TEST_ORIGIN=https://download-test.deepseek.com`, `DOWNLOAD_TEST_COS_BUCKET=bj-toc-download-test-1320056602`, and `DOWNLOAD_TEST_COS_SECRET_ID` / `DOWNLOAD_TEST_COS_SECRET_KEY`. Only those two upload secrets enter the COS client; never put them in commands or records. The transport restricts requests to the test bucket and private Windows qualification paths. The binary-upload operation adds a bucket-versioning query and refuses writes unless the query succeeds with neither enabled nor suspended status. Feed publication reuses a successful binary-upload receipt instead of repeating that query or downloading binaries. COS documents that [`x-cos-forbid-overwrite`](https://cloud.tencent.cn/document/product/436/7749) does not protect objects in versioned buckets. A denied query leaves that configuration unknown; it does not establish that uploads are denied. Use one publisher across all machines. A local `publication.lock` excludes overlapping operations sharing the material directory, not other machines. Version 2 publication checks the existing version 1 feed before replacement; this read and write are not an atomic compare-and-swap. No other publisher may write the same feed concurrently. ## Operator sequence These are pending manual steps, not completed remote qualification. Run from the repository root with the retained manifest, exact version, and matching verification receipt. Without `--execute`, both commands print a local plan and send no request: ```powershell node --import tsx apps/desktop/scripts/publish-installed-update.ts upload-binaries "" "" "" node --import tsx apps/desktop/scripts/publish-installed-update.ts publish-feed "" "" "" ``` 1. Check both versions locally. For each separately authorized upload, append `--execute` to `upload-binaries` and type `UPLOAD ` in an interactive terminal. Installer and blockmap uploads never publish a feed. Matching existing binaries are read back, not overwritten; different bytes stop the operation. 2. Leave the fixed feed absent. Install and start version 1 through its installed shortcut; confirm its displayed version and journal `workspace-ready`. Complete the walkthrough's 404 case before authorizing any feed write. Keep version 1 running. 3. Authorize version 1 `publish-feed` with `--execute` and `PUBLISH `. Its binaries must already exist and pass public readback. The initial feed must be absent or contain the exact version 1 bytes. After full feed readback, complete the same-version case in the running version 1 application; retain evidence and obtain separate authorization before publishing version 2. 4. Authorize version 2 publication with the command below and its exact confirmation. Supply the original installed application's `dsh-update-qualification//journals` directory. Startup evidence and the expected previous feed are required. The operator independently verifies the installed path and that version 1 is still running. ```powershell node --import tsx apps/desktop/scripts/publish-installed-update.ts publish-feed "" "" "" --journals "" --execute ``` Continue the walkthrough only after successful publication and public readback. The tool uses fixed public URLs without cache-busting parameters, uploads with `Cache-Control: no-store`, and verifies returned bytes and hashes. Binary uploads retain complete public readback. Feed publication reads only the feed remotely and requires a successful `upload-binaries` result with an exactly matching local plan under this run's `publication-records/operation-*`; missing, failed, or mismatched receipts stop publication. The publication result records the reused receipt path and receipt/plan hashes. This proves prior delivery, not continued availability of immutable objects; do not delete or replace those objects. SDK writes have no automatic retries. ## Evidence and recovery Each operation retains `publication-records/operation-*`: plan, timestamped stages, final result, and feed body when applicable. Records include safe request IDs and available HTTP status, not raw SDK errors or authorization headers. Failure stops later writes; a timeout does not prove that the server rejected an earlier write. Preserve records and remote objects, inspect the last stage and actual remote state, and obtain separate confirmation before another operation. Diagnose `403 AccessDenied` by the exact API: `GetBucketVersioning`, `GetObject`, and `PutObject` require distinct permissions. Before requesting broader access or changing CDN settings, compare retained successful runs and check the failing operation with the current credentials. An added configuration query must not be reported as an upload failure when no upload was attempted. Successful reads alone do not prove current write permission; prefer reviewing an unnecessary new preflight over expanding a least-privilege upload identity. A manually requested later operation verifies matching objects without rewriting them. `alreadyPublished: true` means reconciliation of an existing desired feed, not a new publication; use the original operation's evidence for publication timing. Unexpected feed bytes stop the operation, including attempted replacement of version 2 with version 1. A crash can leave `publication.lock`; confirm no publisher remains and preserve failed records before an operator removes that exact empty directory. Never delete a lock to bypass an active publisher. Qualification COS version queries have a 30-second total deadline, and object reads and PUTs have a 15-minute total deadline. Expiration aborts the underlying HTTP requests and waits for closure before releasing the operation lock; ongoing transfer activity does not extend the budget. ## Dev Note Sequencing tests use an in-memory store; transport tests exercise real SDK serialization with a substituted HTTP handler. Neither certifies COS writes. On 2026-09-14, the current credentials read the retained test probe with HTTP 200 and matching SHA-512, while `GetBucketVersioning` returned 403; no PUT was attempted. A separate 2026-09-11 probe verified test uploads, fixed-feed refresh, and updater download. TODO: review the extra bucket-configuration prerequisite without weakening namespace isolation, integrity checks, or fail-stop behavior; its removal is not implemented by this documentation correction. The later operator-authorized run `installed-update-r5dYNH` retains `object-overwrite-probe/result.json` and `binary-upload/result.json` under `.desktop-build/qualification/`. Creating a new 49-byte test object succeeds; a second PUT of identical bytes with overwrite forbidden returns `409 FileAlreadyExists`, and origin/public hashes remain unchanged. A fixed-run binary-only driver then uploads both signed installers and their blockmaps with the same header, revalidates package receipts, and verifies all four complete public responses. It records four successful new-object PUTs, no retries, no feed or configuration writes, and keeps the probe. A HEAD observation of the private feed URL returns 404. This operator run uses observed object-level protection instead of querying bucket configuration; the general CLI prerequisite above remains unchanged. These receipts establish test-object delivery, not feed publication, installed startup, or an installed upgrade.

--- description: "将测试二进制上传与人工授权的固定 feed 发布分离，用于 Windows 安装版更新验收。" --- # 测试更新上传与发布 [English](README.md) | 中文 ## 摘要 上传两个已验证版本而不公布版本 2，待操作者启动已安装的版本 1 后才发布版本 2 的固定 feed。默认命令检查本地物料，不读取凭据或联网。实际 COS 写入需要另行获得人工授权并验证。 ## 目录 - [前提条件](#prerequisites) - [人工操作顺序](#sequence) - [证据与恢复](#evidence) - [开发备注](#dev-note) ## 前提条件 完成[演练指南](../README.zh.md)中的两个安装包验证。保留通过的 `verification/check-*/result.json` 回执及未修改物料。发布工具将回执与当前安装包、blockmap、feed 和清单字节重新核对。它绝不签名或安装任何文件。 现有 `.env.windows` 加载器提供 `DSH_DESKTOP_AUTO_UPDATE_ENV=test`、`DOWNLOAD_TEST_ORIGIN=https://download-test.deepseek.com`、`DOWNLOAD_TEST_COS_BUCKET=bj-toc-download-test-1320056602` 及 `DOWNLOAD_TEST_COS_SECRET_ID` / `DOWNLOAD_TEST_COS_SECRET_KEY`。只有这两个上传秘密进入 COS 客户端；绝不放入命令或记录。传输实现将请求限制在 test 存储桶和独立的 Windows 验收路径内。 二进制上传操作额外查询存储桶版本控制；查询成功且既非启用也非暂停状态之前，它拒绝写入。feed 发布复用成功的二进制上传回执，不重复查询桶配置或下载安装包。COS 文档说明 [`x-cos-forbid-overwrite`](https://cloud.tencent.cn/document/product/436/7749) 无法保护开启版本控制的存储桶中的对象。查询被拒绝仅意味着该配置未知，不能证明上传被拒绝。 所有机器只使用一个发布者。本地 `publication.lock` 排除共享物料目录的重叠操作，不限制其他机器。版本 2 发布在替换前检查现有版本 1 feed；该读取与写入不是原子的比较并交换操作。其他发布者不得并发写入同一个 feed。 ##
