# Electron updater compatibility

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

The adapter in `src/updates/electron-updater/` owns library channel policy, cache retirement and Electron HTTP handling. This qualification calls that adapter directly; coordinator, configuration and UI regressions belong to ordinary tests.

Every PR runs a Node-only version check in Windows CI. `verified-versions.json` records the installed Electron, electron-updater and its builder-util-runtime versions separately for Windows and macOS. Missing records, `null` (pending qualification), and version mismatches all fail the check. Git retains prior records. No Electron process or network access is required by this check.

After changing those dependencies, the adapter, or its qualification scripts, run on each affected native platform from the repository root:

```sh
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm --filter @ipollo/desktop exec install-electron
pnpm --filter @ipollo/desktop run test:updates:channels --record
```

Workspace dependencies must already be built (`pnpm run build:artifacts` on a fresh checkout). The final command rebuilds Desktop, runs Electron without opening a window, and records only the current platform after successful exit. Commit the JSON change with the dependency or adapter change. Omit `--record` to test without changing records. The lightweight check compares versions only; unchanged versions do not certify modified adapter code.

The fixture uses a private temporary directory and loopback HTTP feed with inert payloads. It checks channel filenames, downgrade rejection, staging eligibility, downloaded-cache retirement, rejection of obsolete cache by a new updater instance, and macOS proxy closure. It never executes an installer or contacts a production feed. Dependency installation can require external network access. A 30-second watchdog bounds Electron startup, tests and exit; timeout or failure never updates records. Signed installation and application restart remain separate qualification work.

# Electron updater 兼容性

[English](README.md) | 中文

`src/updates/electron-updater/` 中的适配层负责库的渠道策略、缓存撤销和 Electron HTTP 处理。本验证直接调用该适配层；协调器、配置和 UI 回归由常规测试负责。

每个 PR 在 Windows CI 中运行纯 Node 版本检查。`verified-versions.json` 分别记录 Windows 和 macOS 已验证的实际 Electron、electron-updater 及其 builder-util-runtime 版本。缺少记录、`null`（待验证）或版本不匹配都会使检查失败。Git 保留历史记录。此检查不启动 Electron，也不访问网络。

修改这些依赖、适配层或验证脚本后，在每个受影响的原生平台上从仓库根目录运行：

```sh
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm --filter @ipollo/desktop exec install-electron
pnpm --filter @ipollo/desktop run test:updates:channels --record
```

需要先构建 workspace 依赖（新检出目录运行 `pnpm run build:artifacts`）。最后一条命令重新构建 Desktop，启动不打开窗口的 Electron，并且只在成功退出后记录当前平台。将 JSON 改动与依赖或适配层改动一起提交。不带 `--record` 可只测试、不改记录。轻量检查只比较版本；版本未变不代表修改后的适配层已经通过验证。

fixture 使用独立临时目录、回环 HTTP 服务和惰性载荷，检查渠道清单文件名、降级拒绝、灰度资格、下载缓存撤销、新 updater 实例拒绝旧缓存，以及 macOS 代理关闭。它不执行安装器，也不访问生产更新源。安装依赖可能需要外网。30 秒看门狗覆盖 Electron 启动、测试和退出；超时或失败不会更新记录。签名安装和应用重启另行验证。

# Contributing to iPolloWork

Read the [license](LICENSE) before using or contributing code. Describe bugs with the
iPolloWork version, DSH version, operating system, reproduction steps and a redacted error message. Never include API keys, cookies, account tokens, private documents or complete session logs.

Run `npm run setup:build` to prepare the pinned official DSH dependency. Keep changes in `plugins/`, `services/` or the product-owned `integrations/` directories. Do not modify `.upstream/dsh`: new capabilities use official extension points or independent services. Propose missing upstream capabilities separately.

Before developing or reviewing a plugin, follow the [plugin development standard](docs/plugin-development.zh.md), including its DSH architecture and UI requirements. The [repository skill](.agents/skills/ipollowork-plugin-development/SKILL.md) applies the same standard to agent-assisted work and is required by [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md).

For a change, run the owning package's checks plus `npm test`, `npm run check:upstream` and `npm run check:docs`. Runtime changes also need a real profile test. Test the public plugin in the official client and the branded client with their respective activation policies. State exactly what was tested and which platforms remain unverified.

Keep original author and license notices. Normal commits and file moves preserve history; do not rewrite shared history to change contributor attribution. Pull requests should explain the user-visible problem, the resulting behavior and verification.

# Security reports

Do not publish credentials, private session contents or exploit details in a public issue.
Report suspected vulnerabilities through the repository's private vulnerability reporting feature when available, or contact the repository owner privately before disclosing details.

Include the affected iPolloWork and DSH versions, platform, reproduction steps, impact and any mitigation. Redact tokens and personal data. The project has no published response-time guarantee.

Plugins run with their host's permissions. The branded client's protected application entries prevent ordinary plugin-manager changes; they are not a tenant-isolation or filesystem-security mechanism. Follow the official DSH security documentation for the pinned runtime and review third-party plugins before enabling them.

# PPT 模板生成与 Design 编辑检查（2026-11-19）

## 定位结果

本机这次会话选择了 `ipollowork.pptx-ipollo-vi-enterprise`，原模板有 38 页。实际生成文件被改写为另一套 12 页蓝色设计，并包含不合适的文章标记。旧实现只传递文件路径、模板 ID 和 HTML 交付约定，未注册 Design Skill，也未将模板的应用清单带入上下文。格式改为 HTML 并不能保证保留模板视觉。

## 修复

- Design 包注册并携带原生 `ipollowork-design` Skill；其正文自动进入当前 Design 会话的必需上下文，避免模型漏掉单独加载步骤。模型仍使用 DSH 的原生 Agent、Skill、文件和权限服务。
- 必需上下文附带当前模板的分类、清单和 manifest 路径，明确作为来源数据处理。
- 新增 `design_edit_text`：分页读取文字位置，按版本批量替换文字，保留版式、图片、字体、脚本和幻灯片结构。旧版本、重复位置、只读及跨工作区请求会被拒绝；切换文件与写入串行处理。
- 局部修改只读取目标所在区域；完整新稿才要求检查所有页面，避免只改封面却读取整套 600 个文字位置。
- 企业 VI 模板接入颜色、字体和字号比例变量，默认视觉值保留。固定版式隐藏无效的全局背景装饰、圆角、间距和阴影控件；元素仍可单独编辑。
- PDF 导出增加后台窗口等待兜底，并跳过克隆其他页，避免后台导出停在动画帧等待。
- 元素属性先解析百分比、`cqw`、`calc()` 与主题变量，再提供给像素控件，修复调整尺寸/字号时突然缩小的问题。浮动“调整属性”直接切到“元素”，不会误停在主题页。
- 补测修复主题重置：自定义模板恢复当前文件载入时的值，关闭并重新打开属性面板后仍然有效；已应用主题则恢复该主题，不再误用正在浏览的第一套主题。

## 验证范围

从实际归档安装的隔离 DSH 客户端验证：应用同一模板、加载 Skill、模型读取和修改文字、HTML 文件卡片与链接进入 Design、文字编辑、撤销、保存和重开、38 页翻页、属性/字体/字号调整、选中元素发送 AI 编辑指令、全屏及 390px 明暗主题。

PPTX 实际下载，检查 ZIP 内容确认 38 页、编辑文字及原生文本/形状对象。PDF 实际下载。文字工具回归验证只有选中文字发生字节变化，其余模板内容保持不变。独立 Design 和 Design/Video 组合安装通过；构建、类型、源码、归档和相关自动化检查通过。

原生 Agent 链路先使用受控测试模型，再用当前开发版的实际 DeepSeek V4 Pro 验证封面替换：仍为 38 页，标题以外的 HTML 逐字节相同。该用例不能等同于所有主题、所有线上模型的完整内容质量验收。图片/语音/视频等第三方生成服务需要各自的可用配置，本次未消耗这些服务。分享网页涉及外部发布，未在测试中执行发布。

真实模型的一轮试验在完成文件写入后遇到 `IPW_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`，没有把它算作成功交付。收紧局部读取指引后，新会话在 4 步、26 秒内完成读取、修改和 HTML 文件卡片交付，并从卡片打开当前开发版的 Design；38 页与非目标内容的字节比较均通过。

# Dependency and application storage maintenance

The iPolloWork-owned runtime, suite and cloud-image manifests override Undici 8 to 8.12.4, MCP client to 2.4.0 and fflate to 0.8.3. The suite's direct Undici 7 dependency is 7.30.2. Desktop packaging applies the same transitive versions. Publisher overrides UUID below 11.1.1 to 11.1.1. Official DSH source remains unchanged. Run `npm run audit:dependencies` to audit the four owned lockfiles; CI runs the same gate. This gate measures published dependency advisories, not all possible source vulnerabilities or container OS packages.

Service and sandbox image defaults use Node 24.22.3. Existing installed official clients need an updated dependency installation or a newly built iPolloWork package; changing this repository does not silently patch them.

Application records reject inline data URLs, temporary blob URLs, common image encodings and Node Buffer JSON. Files use the existing private object store, with metadata in schema 11. Local fixture tests use disk and mocked OSS transfers; live OSS, container scans and cloud configuration still require deployment validation. See the [application-data documentation](../services/ipollowork/docs/app-data.md).

# Two delivery channels

## iPolloWork desktop

The website distributes a branded desktop installer. Run `npm run setup:build`, then `npm run package:desktop:mac:arm64 -- --unsigned --dir` for a local macOS build. The desktop bundles the same `@ipollo/dsh-suite` package and the pinned official DSH runtime. Operating-system identity, the native login window and update packaging belong to this client.

The selected `@ipollo/desktop-host` application bundle mounts the shared suite modules through the official Include plugin. DSH protects the application bundle from disabling and removal; its nested application entries are not editable through the ordinary plugin switches. The public suite bundle is not selected separately in this client. This is application configuration, not protection against editing local files.

## Plugin for a DSH host

Run `npm run package:plugin` to produce `dist/ipollo-dsh-suite-<version>.tgz` and `dist/plugin-release.json`. Install the tarball through the official client's Plugins page 
…[内容超出评审预算——仅保留首尾各 1024 字符]…
all the bundle on their DSH server; a browser-only page cannot install Host plugins.

The plugin supplies iPolloWork branding inside the application, account and enterprise entry points, curated marketplace, agents, IM and service connections. The host's OS name/icon and native welcome screen remain host-owned. Version 0.1.25 is verified against the official 0.2.2-rc.3 desktop release and the pinned source build. It uses the host's existing authentication: the release's built-in verifier or the source build's scoped authentication provider.

The public plugin displays as **iPolloWork** and remains disableable and removable through the host's official plugin manager. Disabling it retracts its UI and tools without deleting saved project data.

Both channels use the same account service and plugin sources. Downloading the official dependency for development does not put its source into Git or copy the complete source repository into an installer. Changing a delivery channel does not create another Agent engine.

# 两种交付方式

## iPolloWork 客户端

网站提供品牌客户端安装包。执行 `npm run setup:build`，再执行 `npm run package:desktop:mac:arm64 -- --unsigned --dir` 构建本地 macOS 版本。客户端内置同一个 `@ipollo/dsh-suite` 套件及固定版本的官方 DSH 运行时。系统名称、原生登录窗口和升级打包由这个客户端负责。

插件提供应用内的 iPolloWork 品牌、账户与企业入口、精选市场、智能体、IM 和服务连接。系统名称、图标及原生欢迎窗口仍由宿主管理。0.1.25 已验证官方 0.2.2-rc.3 桌面发行包和固定的源码构建。插件沿用宿主认证：发行包的内置校验，或源码构建中按作用域注册的认证服务。

公共插件直接显示为 **iPolloWork**，允许通过宿主的官方插件管理器停用和卸载。停用会撤销界面及工具，不删除已保存的项目数据。

两种方式共用账户服务和插件源码。开发时下载官方依赖，不会把官方源码放入 Git，也不会把完整源码仓库复制进安装包。切换交付方式不产生第二套 Agent 引擎。

## Measured comparison

The official DSH 0.2.2-rc.3 macOS arm64 DMG is 276,328,312 bytes (263.5 MiB), read from its production download endpoint. The first corrected iPollo DMG is 551,245,746 bytes (525.7 MiB). The official application's dependency payload totals about 404 MiB. iPollo's slim dependency payload totals about 445 MiB; the main additional package is the iPollo suite (27 MiB including its nested dependencies), followed by service/IM dependencies. # App data

App data lets plugins, websites, apps and mini programs built in DSH keep records in the signed-in iPolloWork account. The account service stores them in a separate database and accepts only JSON statements; see [the service reference](../../../services/ipollowork/docs/app-data.md) for limits, permissions and the statement format.

## Switch

App data is the `ipollowork-app-data` entry of the iPolloWork bundle (`@ipollo/dsh-suite/app-data`), enabled by default. Disabling it in the plugin manager withdraws the `ipolloData` service, the `app_data` tool, the `app-data` skill and the routes at once; the Data page reports that app data is switched off and leaves the sidebar after the page reloads. Records stay in the account service. The entry has no effect while the suite's account features are off.

## Data page

The sidebar's Data entry opens one tab for personal apps and one per organization the account belongs to, including organizations without apps. Filters show all apps, plugins or public apps

all`, `count`, `aggregate`, `update`, `increment`, `upsert` and `delete` send the matching statements. A statement on an app that was deleted opens the app again and runs once more. Both services build the handle with `createDataApp`. The browser service calls the suite's same-origin routes and rejects with `AppDataError`, whose `code` is stable and whose message carries the service's explanation. Plugins hold no token or connection string.


## Attachments

Both Host and Client `ipolloData` handles expose `app.files.upload(name, bytes, {mime, public?})`, `app.files.download(id)` and `app.files.remove(id)`. `bytes` is a `Uint8Array`; files are limited to 24 MiB. Upload returns file metadata; store its `id` in a record. The Host returns a signed URL from `download`; the Client returns an authenticated same-origin download URL. Only managers may set `public:true`. Files stay in private OSS in production, while PostgreSQL holds ownership and metadata. Inline binary records are refused with `DATA_BINARY_INLINE`.

# Suite architecture

The distribution unit is `@ipollo/dsh-suite`, declared by `dsh.bundle.patch`. Host and browser code remain separate. The Host owns account network traffic and credentials; the browser receives only display records. Browser contributions use `plugins.tab`, `settings.section`, `settings.launcher`, and the two sidebar brand slots. Plugin installation is delegated to the `plugins.tab` owner's callback.

DSH's plugin inventory is the sole installation authority. The repository's format-1 catalog is the sole curated source. The credential provider owns one versioned, origin-bound session-token record. Token records are not mirrored into local storage, Session logs, or frontend configuration. The agent module uses DSH's native storage domain for reusable definitions, credential references, and project memory; it introduces no separate database server.

Cloud profiles disable native personal-key provider entries and accept streaming calls only through suite account providers. ## Enterprise models

Managers connect an OpenAI-compatible endpoint with the enterprise's own key. The editor offers provider presets, tests the address and key, lists the provider's models and sends a one-token chat completion. Enterprise models are stored beside official services and owned through `enterprise_services`. Their calls use the enterprise key, follow the model's audience and record zero points. Official administration cannot list or overwrite them. Granted members see them in the native model picker as `<enterprise> · <title>`.

Enterprise endpoints must be public HTTPS hosts. Loopback endpoints are accepted only when the account service itself runs on a loopback origin for development. Host names that resolve to private addresses are not rejected; deployments that expose internal HTTPS services should restrict outbound traffic from the account service.

# 组织项目与本地工作区

组织项目保存团队共享的产物、待接纳改动和已接纳记忆。本地工作区保存当前电脑上的会话和文件。关联工作区后，每一轮 AI 工作都会重新检查项目权限并读取已接纳的记忆；普通聊天、本地文件修改不会自动上传为组织项目内容。

4. 维护者在“改动”中审阅并接纳。项目文件或记忆更新，概览中的贡献记录和版本随之更新。关联工作区之后的新一轮 AI 工作会读取新版记忆。
5. 分享整段对话：在会话页面分享给指定组织成员，接收者到组织空间的“共享会话”复制打开。组织项目不会自动收录所有本地聊天。

# Alibaba Sandbox plugin

The iPolloWork bundle ships the optional execution-tool Cordis plugin `@ipollo/dsh-suite/aliyun-sandbox`. It reuses the earlier Alibaba Agent Sandbox adapter and its execution lifecycle. DSH owns all Agent execution, tool dispatch and Session recording. This module does not launch a second Agent or modify official DSH source. OpenSandbox is deferred and is not exported, installed as an SDK dependency, or included in this package's output.

The component is disabled in `cordis.patch.yml`. Installing iPolloWork does not make a sandbox request. Configure it in an isolated cloud Agent preset, or enable it on a dedicated cloud Host. Local projects keep their existing native tools and configuration. The plugin follows DSH's read-only policy and refuses sandbox operations in that mode. Its cloud filesystem does not enforce DSH's local `workspace-write` path restrictions: isolation is provided by the remote sandbox and authorized mount.

# 阿里云沙箱插件

iPolloWork 包含可选执行工具 Cordis 插件 `@ipollo/dsh-suite/aliyun-sandbox`，复用已有的阿里云 Agent Sandbox 适配器及执行生命周期。DSH 负责智能体执行、工具调度和会话记录，不新增智能体或修改官方源码。OpenSandbox 暂缓交付，不导出其入口、不安装其 SDK，也不包含旧构建文件。

组件在 `cordis.patch.yml` 中默认关闭，安装 iPolloWork 不会创建云资源。云端 Agent 预设或专用云端 Host 可启用该组件；本地项目继续使用原有工具和配置。只读会话会拒绝沙箱操作。远端文件系统的隔离由沙箱和挂载权限保证，不等同于 DSH 本地 `workspace-write` 路径限制。

## 配置

部署人员通过官方 `dsh` profile 启动器和配置补丁启用插件。密钥仅在 Host 环境变量中，不写入配置文件、模型参数或浏览器存储。用户不填写端点、密钥或 OSS 参数。[完整 YAML 示例和参数](sandbox-plugins.md#operator-configuration)。

配置行使用 `id: ipollowork-aliyun-sandbox`、`disabled: false`，以及 `apiUrl`、`domain`、`apiKeyEnv`、`template` 和 `releaseAfterTurn`。端点与模板以部署账号控制台为准。E2B SDK 固定为已有适配器测试的 2.31.0，不替代 DSH。

插件提供 `sandbox_exec`、`sandbox_read_file`、`sandbox_write_file` 和 `sandbox_release`，结果通过 DSH 原生工具卡片展示并写入会话。首次调用才创建沙箱；取消或失败后释放环境，释放失败的环境不得复用；关闭插件会释放资源并等待已接收操作结束。远端释放无法确认时，由提供方 TTL 兜底。

## 持久化与移动端

未绑定项目时文件属于临时沙箱，启用 `releaseAfterTurn` 会在回合完成后连文件一起删除。持久化模式需配置 `project: { serviceUrl, projectId, tokenEnv }` 和 `storage: { bucket, endpoint, roleArn }`。后台必须在每次操作前通过 `GET /api/v1/projects/:id/runtime` 授权，返回已有项目卷格式。授权失效或响应无效时停止执行并释放保留的沙箱，不退回临时目录。

阿里云将获授权的项目标识映射到 OSS 的 `/ipollowork/<volume-identity>/`，挂载到 `/mnt/project`。模板必须提供 `mountpoint`；挂载验证失败会释放沙箱并中止任务。生产使用前仍需验证 RAM 权限与真实存储行为，不能仅凭挂载配置宣称租户隔离。

当前 PostgreSQL 服务已增加项目卷授权与云端启动接口。可选云端项目组件在阿里云沙箱中启动完整官方 DSH profile，因此普通 DSH 终端与文件工具在云端执行，不通过 `sandbox_*` 工具替换本地工具。配置、资源归属、验证范围和限制见[云端项目](cloud-projects.zh.md)。旧 SQLite 服务和本机子进程启动器不合入。

## 验证

`npm run check` 构建插件入口、执行类型检查和测试，覆盖真实 E2B SDK 的本地 HTTP 交互、官方 DSH Agent 循环调用、只读权限拒绝、项目授权和资源清理。工具定义快照位于 `tests/expected/sandbox-tools.schemas.json`。这些测试不创建付费云资源，也不代表真实阿里云和 OSS 已联调通过。

发布包不依赖相邻工作目录，也不包含 DSH 上游实现。[阿里云 SDK 文档](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/functioncompute/using-the-cloud-sandbox-via-the-sdk)、[OSS 动态挂载文档](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/agent-sandbox/mount-oss-dynamically-1)。

# App data

App data gives small plugins, websites, apps and mini programs a hosted record store without a database of their own. Callers send JSON statements; they never see SQL, tables or connection strings. Larger systems that need joins, server-side logic or payments should run their own back end.

## Storage

Records live in a separate PostgreSQL database named by `APP_DATA_DATABASE_URL` (optional `APP_DATA_DATABASE_SCHEMA`). The service refuses to start when it names the account database and schema. Without the variable, every `/api/data/v1` route answers `APP_DATA_NOT_CONFIGURED`; nothing falls back to the account database. Migrations use `app_data_schema`; schema 2 adds each app's kind and classifies existing apps with public collections as sites, schema 3 adds tombstone removal and named rate buckets, schema 4 adds strict collections, and schema 5 adds suspension, visitor access and roles; schema 6 binds cloud-created applications to their authorized project. A service older than the database's schem
…[内容超出评审预算——仅保留首尾各 1024 字符]…
efore buffering. The response is `{id,name,mime,bytes,sha256}`; save `id` in the app record. Read `GET /api/data/v1/apps/:app/files/:id`; delete with `DELETE` at the same URL. Reads return a short-lived signed OSS URL in production. Only app managers can mark a file public; private files are limited to the uploader and app managers. Anonymous uploads are refused. Signed-in visitor uploads require a collection that permits user creation or ownership.

Files use the existing object store and owner storage quota. Production requires private OSS; local tests may use the service-owned cache. Migration 11 stores file metadata in `app_data_files` in the account database, never file bodies. The app ID is checked against the independent app-data database, so there is no cross-database foreign key. Deleted-app files are removed in bounded background batches; failed deletion retains quota accounting and retries. Deleting a record does not delete its attachment automatically because other records may still reference it.

This reference covers server-supplied credentials and credit accounting. Private keys are edited in the service center and are never returned in the public catalog. Plugins may select their own native credentials instead; BYOK requests do not debit this service's ledger.

Alibaba includes ten recommended language models from Qwen, DeepSeek, MiniMax, Kimi, GLM and MiMo. The editor can show the complete saved catalog, and search covers every saved model and author. # Capability HTTP API

English | [中文](capabilities.zh.md)

The account service exposes model capabilities over HTTP. Native iPolloWork tools and external applications use the same authorization, provider routing, actual-usage billing and request receipts. Provider keys stay in server settings; external access keys never grant account administration or file access.

## Discover and describe

Create an access key from **Service center → API access**. The plaintext appears once. Send it as `Authorization: Bearer <key>` or `X-API-Key: <key>`. Existing account session tokens continue to work. Query `GET /api/v1/capabilities` for concise entries; `?kind=image` filters by kind. Supported kinds are `chat`, `image`, `video`, `speech`, `transcription`, `embedding` and `rerank`. Only enabled, authorized, priced services with a supported protocol and a configured invocation route appear. A kind supported by the API is not evidence that the deployment has an available model of that kind.

`GET /api/v1/capabilities/:id` re

`name` and optional `expiresIn` seconds. Key management requires an ordinary account session; an access key cannot mint other keys. Better Auth owns key hashing, expiry, ownership and its `apikey` table. Startup applies the plugin's additive authentication migration through the existing migration runner. Back up PostgreSQL and the authentication secret before deployment. Business `service_schema` and existing receipts are unchanged; no parallel task or billing table is created.

The native tools are `ipollo_capabilities`, `ipollo_capability_describe`, `ipollo_capability_invoke` and `ipollo_capability_task`. # 能力 HTTP API

[English](capabilities.md) | 中文

账号服务通过 HTTP 提供模型能力。iPolloWork 原生工具和外部应用共用授权、供应商路由、实际用量计费和调用回执。供应商 Key 保存在服务端配置中；外部访问 Key 不授予账号管理或文件访问权限。

## 查询和描述

在**服务中心 → API 接入**中创建访问 Key，完整内容只显示一次。请求使用 `Authorization: Bearer <key>` 或 `X-API-Key: <key>`；原有账号会话 Token 仍可使用。`GET /api/v1/capabilities` 返回简短能力列表，`?kind=image` 按类型过滤。API 支持 `chat`、`image`、`video`、`speech`、`transcription`、`embedding` 和 `rerank`。列表只包含已启用、已授权、已定价且具备受支持协议和调用路由的服务；API 支持某种类型不代表当前部署已有可用模型。

`GET /api/v1/capabilities/:id` 返回输入 JSON Schema、模型 ID、限制和调用地址。模型列表默认每页 25 项，可使用 `offset`、`limit`（最多 100）和返回的 `nextOffset`；`?model=<id>` 查看单个模型。输入描述任务而非供应商接口：图片和视频使用 `prompt`，语音合成使用 `text`、`voice`，识别使用 `audio`，向量使用 `texts`，重排使用 `query`、`documents`。完整参数以接口返回的当前 schema 为准。

# PostgreSQL capacity sample

## HTTP admission for the 100-user trial

Employees run Agent and Electron on their own computers. The shared service handles identity, metadata, model/MCP forwarding, private OSS and publications. This budget does not cover hosting 100 Agent processes, local models or video rendering on one ECS instance.

The default process admits 32 control requests, 2 password operations, 8 model/capability calls, 4 transfers and 128 MCP transports independently. Each lane has at most 160 waiting requests. Control requests wait up to 5 seconds, password operations 20 seconds, and model/transfers 120 seconds; exceeding the bound returns `503` with `Retry-After`. Waiting requests do not reserve credits or submit provider jobs. Client cancellation removes waiting work and cancels forwarded model requests. There is no automatic replay of an uncertain paid call.

`/api/health` checks the process. `/api/ready` checks PostgreSQL and draining. Authenticated administrators can inspect `/api/v1/admin/r
…[内容超出评审预算——仅保留首尾各 1024 字符]…
 its own schema and leaves working data untouched. Run against a dedicated test database.

A local run on 2026-11-14 used Apple M5, Node 25.8.1 and PostgreSQL 15.13. The workload contained 500,000 users, 1,000 organizations, 500,000 memberships, 100,000 projects, 100,000 file-index rows and 500,200 ledger rows.

| Measurement | Observed result |
| --- | --- |
| Seed time | 14.66 s |
| Wallet and membership reads, concurrency 50, P95 | 10.83 ms |
| Atomic wallet writes, concurrency 20, P95 | 4.46 ms |
| Database size | About 854 MiB |
| Node resident memory | About 161 MiB |

These numbers measure indexed SQL access and row-locked writes, not 500,000 simultaneous users, HTTP authentication, OSS transfers, model throughput or WebSocket fan-out. Production sizing needs the expected active-user ratio, request rate, server resources, connection-pool budget and regional latency. Use managed PostgreSQL backups and monitoring for online operation. The process-local native relay remains a separate scaling constraint.

# 百人内测容量与运行边界

员工各自在电脑上运行 Electron 和 Agent；ECS 负责账号、组织、项目、模型与 MCP 转发、OSS 文件接口和发布。2 核 4G 的规划不包括在这台机器运行一百个 Agent、本地模型或视频渲染。

服务分别允许 32 个普通接口、2 个密码操作、8 个模型/能力调用、4 个文件传输和 128 个 MCP 传输并发；每组最多排队 160 个请求。普通接口最多等 5 秒，密码操作 20 秒，模型与文件传输 120 秒。超过容量或等待时间，返回明确的 `503` 和 `Retry-After`，不会无限累积内存。排队时不扣积分、不提交模型任务；取消排队后不再执行。无法确认结果的付费调用不会自动重试，以免重复消费。

`/api/health` 检查进程存活，`/api/ready` 检查数据库和停机状态。平台管理员可调用 `/api/v1/admin/runtime` 查看队列、内存、事件循环及数据库连接数，不返回密钥或请求正文。请配置站外可用性、内存、磁盘、数据库和排队告警。单台 ECS 和同机数据库仍有单点故障风险，需要外部备份和恢复演练。

使用独立测试数据库设置 `TEST_DATABASE_URL` 后运行 `npm run bench:http`。脚本自行创建并删除随机命名的隔离 schema，用真实 HTTP 服务、120 个合成账号和本地模拟模型上游验证。2026 年 11 月 19 日的 Windows 测试中，120 个同出口并发登录、360 次鉴权查询、120 次模型调用和重复请求重放均成功，没有重复扣费。登录耗时 5.469 秒，查询 1.797 秒，模型阶段 6.353 秒；模型最大并发 8、最多排队 112、服务进程 RSS 峰值 256 MiB、存活检查 P95 为 7 毫秒。子进程 V8 堆限制为 768 MiB，模拟上游每次延迟 350 毫秒。宿主为 4 物理核、16 GB、PostgreSQL 18。这证明排队等功能在该测试负载下有效，尚不能作为 2 核 4G Linux 真机、真实供应商额度或长时间稳定性的达标证明。

# Storage and deployment

This reference describes service-owned metadata and objects. Native DSH workspaces, input attachments and complete local conversation state remain outside cloud retention.

## Ownership and lifetime

Each object has one personal or organization owner, its exact byte count, project reference and state. PostgreSQL reserves bytes under an owner row lock before upload. A completed object becomes used capacity only once; metadata attachment shares the resource transaction. Failed or abandoned uploads release capacity after confirmed object deletion. A staged upload expires after `UPLOAD_RESERVATION_MS`; a server-side cleanup pass runs every `STORAGE_CLEANUP_INTERVAL_MS`.

| Output owner | Default quota | Retention |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Personal, unpublished project | 200 GiB | Seven days from upload |
| Personal, published project | Same personal quota | Retained |
| Organization | 500 GiB | Retained |

Administrators change a user's or organization's capacity on its detail page. A limi

QLite versions 1–8, verifies integrity, applies historical migrations only to the temporary snapshot and imports in one transaction. A nonempty target is rejected. It verifies table counts and the total ledger balance and adopts file quotas without moving files.
4. Start the service, check `/api/health`, sign in with an existing account, and verify organizations, balance and a private file download. Do not point the retired SQLite service at new writes after switching traffic.

`npm run backup -- /absolute/new/directory` runs `pg_dump --format=custom` and copies service-owned private files and the secret. Run it where a PostgreSQL client of the same or newer major version is installed and can reach the database. The slim application image does not include that client; managed deployments should use database-native backups. Restore dumps with `pg_restore` into a new database, restore the matching secret/data files, and restore OSS from its separate backup policy. Backup completion alone is not a restore test.

## Change

# iPolloWork enterprise analytics

English | [中文](guide.zh.md)

## Change

The independent iPolloWork account service migrates PostgreSQL business data to schema nine. Older service versions reject this schema. The Console includes enterprise service consumption and metadata-only activity from linked projects. Historical unattributed service calls are excluded.

## Migration

1. Back up PostgreSQL and the service authentication secret using the [service deployment instructions](../../../../services/ipollowork/docs/storage.md).
2. Deploy the updated account service before updating the iPolloWork suite. Service startup applies the migration transactionally; verify that `SELECT MAX(version) FROM service_schema` returns `9` in the configured schema.
3. Update the suite and restart its DSH profile. Enterprise administrators can open Console → Analytics. `enterpriseUsageReporting: false` disables project activity reporting in the suite's `cordis.patch.yml` configuration; service gateway consumption is still recorded.
4. Restore the database backup together with the older service if rollback is required. Do not run the older service against schema nine.

# Project collaboration

Deploy the account service with business schema version 3 before updating the suite client. The client uses the work and project-collaboration endpoints in addition to the existing share API. Back up the SQLite file before migration. Version 3 adds project_work and work_revisions and preserves existing identities, projects, shares, and financial records. An older account service must not open this database; restore its matching backup to roll back.

The suite adds Team collaboration inside Enterprise spaces. Continue work creates a separate native Session with the shared reference in its unsent draft. Publish result makes the edited text available to project members, and subsequent updates create versions with an expected-version check. Removing enterprise membership prevents further reads and writes. Revoking the original share prevents new handoffs from it; previously published project results keep project permissions.

A shared HTTPS account-service origin is required for links used on another computer. A localhost origin remains local. No model keys, MCP credentials, or native file trees are copied by a handoff.

# Enterprise project collaboration

The service now migrates SQLite monotonically to version 5, preserving old shares, comments and result history. Back up the service data directory before upgrading. New writes to the legacy snapshot, comment and result endpoints return HTTP 410; use project submissions instead. Existing data is not deleted or converted into a live DSH share.

New project permission levels are View, Participate and Maintain. Existing enterprise-wide visibility is retained until a maintainer changes Access. New project forms explicitly choose their sharing scope. A member removed from the enterprise, or a department grant they leave, loses access on the next request. Project ownership changes clear prior project grants and revoke legacy snapshot links.

The suite now bundles DSH Liveshare. Deploy the matching `ipollowork-services` v5 server at `accountOrigin`, including its WebSocket upgrade route. Sharing authorizes the current iPollo account using native PKCE and binds each native link to a project. Project grants are now also authoritative for those links: revoked project/department access stops new requests and cancels open calls. Existing unrelated native shares are not imported. The native owner header action is replaced through slot priority, and restored when the suite is disabled. Forks remain on the sharing Host and do not create isolated local directories.

主项目维护文件版本和统一记忆。员工提交选中的文件或提炼的知识，维护者接纳；不再创建评论和成果发布记录。文件不会自动同步到本机，共享记忆在关联工作区的每一轮 AI 工作前重新鉴权并读取。原生会话共享使用独立账户服务内的兼容转发模块，部门和项目权限实时生效；不生成自建文字快照。

# Official service center

Deploy the account backend with database version 6 before enabling official services. The migration adds service definitions and invocation receipts and leaves prior tables intact. Operators configure service keys, explicit routes, prices and optional plans in the service console; no provider is enabled or charged by default.

The suite adds the optional Host service `ipolloServices`, with a per-operation binding and an authenticated fetch method. Both native editors may use it while enabled; standalone installations continue resolving DSH credentials. Official source choices persist separately from user keys, and changing a source does not copy or delete a credential. Account changes invalidate existing bindings.

Configured chat model catalogs register additional `ipollo-*` routes through DSH's pi-ai adapter. They do not change existing model choices. Signing out or disabling the suite withdraws these routes. Native DSH BYOK model routes remain available. The service center's own-key choice withdraws the corresponding official model routes rather than copying a user key into a model profile.

Service routes may set `jobResultField` to the dotted response field containing a submitted job id, and `jobField` for a polling request's body/query id. Dynamic `:id` paths and declared polling ids are accepted only for jobs recorded under that account and service. Do not enable a provider's polling endpoint without its job ownership configuration. Configure per-request prices explicitly; this version does not infer token, duration or output-count pricing from vendor bills.

# Stable Design publication URLs

Deploy the account service with schema 8 before using the updated suite publication lookup. Back up PostgreSQL and the authentication secret before migration. The migration adds nullable publication identity and revision links, plus a unique owner/site index; existing publication IDs and URLs remain valid.

Design identifies a site by native workspace and entry path. New revisions upload privately and replace the live revision only after every file is ready. Incomplete or superseded revisions leave the published page unchanged. A unique legacy publication for the same owner, project and entry is adopted on first update. Multiple matching legacy publications fail with `PUBLICATION_AMBIGUOUS` rather than updating an arbitrary page.

The optional Host `publicationInfo(workspaceId, entry)` reports the existing URL to the Design toolbar. This is product plugin and account-service code; DSH remains unchanged.

# Main assistant messaging entry

New IM Sessions now use `ipollo-coordinator` instead of a per-bot specialist preset or the Host default. QR authorization and automatic connection both use this entry point. The main assistant selects saved specialists or creates temporary workers through native DSH delegation; specialists no longer need individual messaging connections.

Existing Sessions keep their recorded preset and history. Send `/new` in an existing chat to use the main assistant. Per-bot model and workspace settings remain effective. Stored earlier preset choices are retained, but the suite's IM UI no longer offers them as direct entry points. Manage those specialists in the Agents page.

Disabling the suite removes the coordinator and IM components. Its Sessions require a version of the suite that provides that preset to resume; older builds do not provide a fallback composition. No DSH Session format, native storage schema, credential or channel-state migration is introduced.
